name: Apollo Lunar Rover
description: Was affectionately known as the moon buggy. It was used on the moon in the last three missions of the American Apollo program (15, 16, 17) during 1971 and 1972. Powered by only two silver-oxide batteries, the Apollo 17 was able to drive for 35.74 km (22.21 miles) across the surface of the moon.

name: USS Arizona
description: Was a Pennsylvania-class battleship, built in the mid-1910s and modernized in 1931.  She was bombed during the attack on Pearl Harbor and sunk on December 7th 1941, killing 1,177 officers and crewmen.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex Skeleton
description: The species Tyrannosaurus rex (rex meaning "king" in Latin), commonly abbreviated to T. rex, is one of the most well-represented of the large theropods. Tyrannosaurus was a bipedal carnivore with a massive skull balanced by a long, heavy tail. Relative to its large and powerful hind limbs, Tyrannosaurus fore limbs were short but unusually powerful for their size and had two clawed digits. It was among the last non-avian dinosaurs to exist before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.

name: Stegosaurus Skeleton
description: The stegosaurus was an armored dinosaur that lived about 150 million years ago. It had a heavily rounded back, short forelimbs, head held low to the ground and a stiffened tail held high in the air. The double plates along its back were most likely used for defense and may also have regulated its temperature. Stegosaurus weighed about 6,800 pounds and was 9 feet tall.

name: Triceratops Skeleton
description: The name from Greek means 3 horned face. This dinosaur was about 30 feet long, 10 feet tall and weighed 4 to 6 tons. Stout limbs supported its girth but it was unlikely the dinosaur could move very quickly. Like a modern-day rhinoceros, it probably spent much of its time grazing on plant matter.

name: Pteranodon Skeleton
description: Pteranodon is a genus of pterosaurs which included some of the largest known flying reptiles with wingspans over 6 meters. They lived about 80 million years ago in North America in present day Kansas, Alabama, Nebraska, Wyoming, and South Dakota.

name: Pan Am China Clipper
description: China Clipper (NC14716) was the first of three Martin M-130 four-engine flying boats built for Pan American Airways. In November of 1935 it was used to inaugurate the first commercial transpacific air service from San Francisco to Manila by way of Honolulu, Midway and Wake Island. It continued to fly the Pacific for the next eight years carrying approximately 3,500 passengers and 750,000 lbs of mail and freight.

name: Japanese (Toyotomi) Armor
description: This model is a replica of the armor worn by Toyotomi Hideyoshi, the preeminent daimyo, warrior, general, samurai, and politician of the Sengoku period and is regarded as Japan's second "great unifier”.

name: Kepler Spacecraft
description: Kepler is a space observatory launched by NASA to discover Earth-size planets orbiting other stars. Named after astronomer Johannes Kepler, the spacecraft was launched on March 7, 2009, into an Earth-trailing heliocentric orbit.

name: Golf Cart Set
description:
Golf Carts are designed to carry golf bags with clubs which eliminates the need for golfers to carry their own clubs or hire a caddy. However, today’s golf carts are also used for transportation in many communities where motor vehicles are restricted. 
  • 3 different color models included. 
  • Easy to build. 
  • 3 models provide back up for the beginner in case of assembly problems. 
  • A nice set of Golf Carts when completed.

name: A-10 Warthog®
description: Is a single seat jet fighter powered by twin turbofan engines. Fairchild-Republic developed the A-10 for the United States Air Force. Commonly referred to as the “Warthog”, this jet fighter is particularly effective at close air support for ground troops.

name: Supermarine Spitfire
description: The most widely produced and strategically important British single-seat fighter of World War II. The Spitfire, renowned for winning victory laurels in the Battle of Britain (1940-41), served in every theatre of the war and was produced in more variants than any other British aircraft.

name: Cessna 182 Floatplane
description: Cessna 182 is a four-seat light aircraft with fixed landing gear that is powered by a 230 hp Continental engine. The plane was designed as the tricycle gear variant of the Cessna 180. Designed with additional cabin space, it has become a popular floatplane for supplying towns and villages in remote areas.

name: Fire Engine
description: Fire engines are specifically designed to fight fires and often include a larger telescopic-ladder mounted on a turntable at the back of the truck's chassis. Most also include a water tank with an onboard pump, a fire hose, an aerial ladder and multiple ground ladders.

name: Moby Dick Book Sculpture
description: Moby Dick, a novel by Herman Melville, is the story of the obsessive quest of Ahab, captain of the whaler the Pequod, for revenge on Moby Dick, the white whale that on the previous whaling voyage bit off Ahab's leg at the knee.

name: The Old Man & The Sea Book Sculpture
description: The Old Man and the Sea is a novel by Ernest Hemingway tells the story of a battle between an aging, experienced fisherman, Santiago, and a large marlin.

name: Messerschmitt Bf-109
description:
Was a German World War II fighter aircraft that first saw operational service during the Spanish Civil War (1939) and later became the backbone of the Luftwaffe's fighter force. The Bf 109 was the most produced fighter aircraft in history with a total of 33,984 airframes produced from 1936 up to April 1945.
Item#:

name: Japanese Rickshaw
description: Is a mode of human-powered transport by which a runner draws a two-wheeled cart which seats one or two people.  An American missionary to Japan, is said to have invented the device around 1869 to transport his invalid wife through the streets of Yokohama.

name: German U-boat Type XXI
description: German U-Boat Type XXI: Were a class of German diesel-electric submarines designed during the Second World War. They were the first submarines able to operate primarily submerged rather than spending most of their time as surface ships.

name: Voyager
description: The Voyager Spacecraft: Consist of two robotic probes that were built by Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California and launched by NASA in 1977. Their primary mission was the exploration of Jupiter and Saturn. Both Voyagers are now tasked with exploring interstellar space.

name: Monarch Butterfly
description: All Metal Earth butterflies are made of 1 sheet colored models and are rated as “Easy” builds.  The upper (dorsal side) and undersides (ventral side) of the forewings and hindwings are decorated in color.The Monarch Butterfly may be the most familiar North American butterfly, and is considered an iconic pollinator species.  Its wings feature an easily recognizable tawny orange, the veins and margins are black, and there are two series of small white spots in the margins.  The Monarch wingspan averages 8-10cm.

name: Buckeye Butterfly
description: The Buckeye is found in southern Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, and Nova Scotia; all parts of the United States except the Northwest.. The bold pattern of eyespots and white bars on the upper wing surface is distinctive in much of its range.  The eyespots likely serve to startle or distract predators, especially young birds.

name: Tiger Swallowtail Butterfly
description: The Tiger Swallowtail is native to eastern North America as well as Turkey.  The male is yellow with four black “tiger stripes” on each forewing.  Females may be either yellow or black, making them dimorphic.  The yellow morph is similar to the male, but with a conspicuous band of blue spots along the hindwing, while the dark morph is almost completely black.  This model is based off of the female yellow morph.

name: Mourning Cloak Butterfly
description: The Mourning Cloak is a large butterfly native to Eurasia and North America.  This powerful flier is sometimes found in areas far from its usual range during migration.  The Mourning Cloak has a lifespan of 11-12 months, one of the most extensive lifespans for any butterfly.

name: Eastern Comma Butterfly
description: The Eastern Comma is native to Northeastern America.  This butterfly is seasonally variable. The upper side of the summer form's hindwings are all black, whereas the winter forms hindwings are reddish orange. The underside of both forms is striped with dark and light brown. There is a silvery comma mark in the middle of the hindwing in both forms. Its wingspan is 4.5–6.4 cm (1.8–2.5 in).

name: Pipevine Swallowtail Butterfly
description: The Pipevine Swallowtail is found in Central and North America.  The upper surface of the hindwings is an iridescent blue or blue green with pale, arrowhead markings.  The underside of the hindwing has seven orange sub marginal spots surrounded by iridescent blue.  Both surfaces of the forewings are black or dull blackish brown.  The Pipevine Swallowtail can have a wingspan up to 3.5 inches (89mm).

name: Red Admiral Butterfly
description: The Red Admiral is found in temperate Europe, Asia and North America.  This medium-sized butterfly is identified by its striking dark brown, red, and black wing pattern. More specifically, the dark wings possess orange bands that cross the forewings and on the outer edge of the hindwings; white spots on the dorsal forewings near the front margin; reddish bars on dorsal surface of all four wings.

name: Red Spotted Purple Butterfly
description: The Red Spotted Purple is native North America with subspecies in Central America. The upper side is mostly blackish-blue with a row of red spots on the forewing. The hindwings are either a bright iridescent blue or an iridescent bluish-green.  Both the males and females look exactly the same but one difference is that the females are larger than the males.

name: Hong Kong Star Ferry
description: Is a passenger ferry service operator and tourist attraction in Hong Kong. Its principal routes carry passengers across Victoria Harbour, between Hong Kong Island and Kowloon. It was founded in 1888 as the Kowloon Ferry Company, adopting its present name in 1898.

name: Chinese (Ming) Armor
description: This model is an example of some of the most magnificent and iconic armor from ancient China. It was worn by the Dahan General, a group of some 1,500 guardians that belonged to the army of the secret service of the Ming Dynasty. Their task was to protect the emperor and the dynasty.

name: European (Knight) Armor
description: The plate armor used for this model is associated with the knights of the European Late Middle Ages.  By about 1400 AD, the full harness of plate armor had been developed which allowed heavy cavalry to dominate the battlefield for more than a century.

name: Horse Armor
description: During the late Middle Ages as armored protection for knights became more effective, their mounts became targets. Barding was developed in response to this vulnerability, The armor consisted mainly of plate armor and hardened leather.

name: Classic Vespa 125™
description: Vespa™ - is an Italian brand motor scooter manufactured by Piaggio™. The name means wasp in Italian. The scooter was first launched in 1946 and by 1960 more than 2 million had been sold. This classic scooter received its greatest sales promo from the feature film Roman Holiday in which Audrey Hepburn was filmed riding side saddle through Rome on Gregory Peck’s Vespa.

name: Old Country Church
description: Most of these churches are recognizable by their Carpenter Gothic design which features timber frame construction, stain glass windows, detailed trim and pointed arched windows and doors. For generations, these churches have served as a second home for many Americans and were the cornerstones of many rural communities.

name: Independence Hall
description: Is the birthplace of America. The Declaration of Independence and U.S. Constitution were both debated and signed inside this building. Also, George Washington was appointed Commander in Chief of the Continental Army in 1775 and the Articles of Confederation were adopted in 1781.

name: Melbourne W-class Tram
description: Is a family of electric trams built between 1923 and 1956. In total 752 trams were built. A small fleet continues to operate on the tramway network of Melbourne. The W-class tram has become a cultural icon and those that remain in Melbourne are classified by the National Trust of Australia.

name: B-1B Lancer™
description: Is a supersonic variable-sweep wing, heavy bomber used by the United States Air Force and is commonly referred to as the bone due to its “B-1” designation.  It is one of three strategic bombers in the U.S. Air Force fleet as of 2018.  The other two are the B-2 Spirit "Stealth Bomber"™ and the B-52 Stratofortress™

name: Monster Truck
description: Is a pickup truck modified with a larger suspension and larger tires, usually for recreational use.

name: F-117® Nighthawk®
description: Is a USAF twin engine stealth attack aircraft that was developed in Lockheed’s secretive Skunk Works division.It was the first operational aircraft to be designed around stealth technology.  The F-117 was well publicized for its role in the Persian Gulf War and remained active until 2008 when it was replaced by the F-22 Raptor®

name: Apollo Saturn V with Gantry
description: Saturn V: President Kennedy said, “we choose to go to the moon”  The Saturn V is how we got there!  This 3-stage expendable rocket was developed by NASA to support the US Apollo space program between 1967 and 1973.  The “V” referenced the five giant F-1 rocket engines clustered at the bottom of the Saturn V’s first stage.

name: Apollo CSM with LM
description: The Apollo 11 moon landing required two spacecraft- The lunar module (LM) and command service module (CSM).  Once in lunar orbit, the two would separate so the LM could land while the CSM waited in orbit.  After launching from the lunar surface, the LM’s ascent stage would rendezvous and dock with the waiting CSM, then the astronauts would transfer back into the main spacecraft and head home.  It sounds nearly impossible but that’s the way it was July 20, 1969.

name: Big Apple Tour Bus
description: The hop-on, hop-off New York City tour bus has become an iconic image around the city.  Similar tour buses have become popular in many large cities as a fun and efficient way to see the sites.

name: Yomei Gate
description: Yomeimon Gate – Is part of the Tosho-gu Shrine in Kikko which is the mausoleum of Tokugawa Ieyasu, the founder of the Tokugawa shogunate. It is one of Japan's most ornate structures, giving off a grand and imposing air with its intricate decorations and architectural features

name: Boeing™ Starliner™
description: Boeing's Crew Space Transportation (CST)-100 Starliner spacecraft is being developed in collaboration with NASA's Commercial Crew Program.The Starliner was designed to accommodate seven passengers or a mix of crew and cargo for missions to low-Earth orbit.

name: 1934 Packard Twelve Convertible
description: This was Packard’s flagship.  It was the car positioned to take on the best from Cadillac and Lincoln throughout the depths of the Great Depression. It was named for its 12 cylinder engine, which was ideal to power Packard’s top model.

name: B-24 Liberator
description: The consolidated B-24 Liberator, first flown in 1939, began active service in 1941 and was the most produced American aircraft of World War II, with 18,482 built. The Liberator was used in every theater of the war and for a variety of missions from long-range bombing and submarine patrol, to transporting high priority cargo and VIPs.DIAMOND LIL was the 18th production B-24 built.Today Diamond Lil is one of two airworthy B-24s.

name: P-51D Mustang Sweet Arlene™
description: Is an American long-range, single-seat fighter and fighter-bomber used during World War II and the Korean War. This P-51D model was flown by Lt. Bowers of the 4th Fighter Group, 334th Squadron. It was named "Sweet Arlene" and was credited with six enemy aircraft destroyed.Instructions to assemble this model with a raised landing gear configuration can be found here:https://www.metalearth.com/flyingp51

name: DeLorean™
description: Produced for the American market by The DeLorean Motor Company in Belfast, Northern Ireland from 1981 to 1983. This sleek angular car featured gull-wing doors and an unpainted brushed stainless steel body. It was immortalized as the DeLorean time machine in the Back to the Future movie franchise.

name: Mining Truck
description: Is an off-highway, rigid dump truck specifically engineered for use in high-production mining and heavy-duty construction environments.

name: Wheel Loader
description: Is a heavy equipment machine used in construction to move aside or load materials such as asphalt, demolition debris, dirt, snow, gravel etc. onto other types of machinery

name: Motor Grader
description: Also commonly referred to as road grader, is a construction machine with a long blade used to create a flat surface during the grading process

name: Excavator
description: Is a heavy construction equipment consisting of a boom, dipper, bucket and cab on a rotating platform known as the "house". The house sits atop an undercarriage with tracks or wheels. It is a natural progression from the steam shovel and often mistakenly called power shovel

name: InSight Mars Lander
description: InSight, short for Interior Exploration using Seismic Investigations, Geodesy and Heat Transport, is a robotic lander designed to study the deep interior of the planet Mars. InSight launched on May 5, 2018 and successfully landed on Mars on Nov. 26, 2018.Its finding are expected to shed light on the processes responsible for the formation of Mars, Earth, and even rocky exoplanets more than 4 billion years ago.

name: Duesenberg J
description: The Duesenberg Model J, powered by a 265 horse power engine, was the fastest and most expensive American automobile on the market when it was first produced. At that time a marketing slogan stated, “The only car that can pass a Duesenberg is another Duesenberg”.

name: T-34 Tank
description: The T-34 Tank was a Soviet tank that was produced from 1940 to 1958. Although its armor and armament were surpassed by later World War II tanks, it has been often credited as the most effective, efficient and influential tank design of WWII.

name: Chi Ha Tank
description: The Chi Ha tank was built by Mitsubishi and designated the CHI-HA. It used the Mitsubishi air-cooled 170 horsepower diesel engine and was regarded as the best tank that Japan had produced during World War II. The main armament consisted of a single 57mm gun mounted in the turret and supported by two 7.7mm self-defense machine guns.

name: Tiger I Tank
description: This German tank was the most powerful tank in the world when it was introduced in August 1942. The 88mm gun was extremely powerful and the heavy armor made it almost impervious to attack. The success of the Tiger was so profound, that no allied tank dared to engage it in open combat. This psychological fear soon became to be known as "Tigerphobia".

name: Sherman Tank
description: The Sherman Tank was the primary tank used by the United States during World War II. The tank was named after Union General William Tecumseh Sherman. Production exceeded 50,000 units. Only the Soviet T-34 tank was produced in larger numbers during World War II. Though it was wholly inadequate against the heavier armed 56 ton German Tiger I and the 72 ton Tiger II, mobility, mechanical reliability and sheer numbers helped offset their disadvantages strategically.

name: M1 Abrams Tank
description: Is an American third-generation main battle tank that entered service in 1980. It features a powerful turbine engine, sophisticated composite armor, and separate ammunition storage in a blow-out compartment for crew safety. Weighing nearly 62 metric tons, it is one of the heaviest battle tanks in service.

name: Fokker Dr.I Triplane™
description: Was flown in World War I by the famous Manfred Von Richthofen. The plane's tri-wing design allowed for superior maneuverability which was critical to WWI dogfighting. Due to the triplane's crimson color, Richthofen was dubbed the 'Red Devil' by the WWI French (this nickname was changed to 'Red Baron' after the war).

name: Space Shuttle Discovery
description: Was the third NASA orbiter to be built.  It first launched August 30, 1984 and remained in service for more than 27 years.  Among its many accomplishments was the work done on the International Space Station and carrying the Hubble Space Telescope into orbit.

name: Space Shuttle Atlantis
description: Is the fourth operational and the second-to-last Space Shuttle built. Atlantis lifted off on its maiden voyage on October 3rd 1985 and became the first Space Shuttle to launch an interplanetary probe to Venus in 1989.

name: V-22 Osprey™
description: Is both a vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) and short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft used by the United States Marine Corps, Air Force and Navy.  Its tiltrotor design allows the Osprey to takeoff and land like a helicopter, then fly as a fixed-wing, turboprop aircraft.

name: P-40 Warhawk
description:
Is an American single-engine ground attack aircraft made famous in combat during World War II by the First American Volunteer Group (AVG) of the Chinese Air Force in 1941-1942, nicknamed the Flying Tigers.
While the P-40 could not match the maneuverability of the opposing Japanese fighters, it was faster in a dive, sturdy and had an excellent roll rate.

name: U-2 Dragon Lady®
description: The U-2 Dragon Lady®is a high-altitude surveillance aircraft, designed to fly at 70,000 feet and featuring a 103 foot wing span. The U-2®served the United States during the Cold War and at peak altitude, it could not be tracked by radar, nor shot down.

name: Monster Truck (Flame)
description: Monster Truck is a specialized truck with a larger suspension and oversized tires, usually for competition and recreational uses.

name: R2-D2™
description: R2-D2 is a robot character in the Star Wars Universe. An Astromech droid is a major character in all Star Wars Films.

name: Millennium Falcon™
description: A legendary starship despite its humble origins and deceptively dilapidated exterior, the Millennium Falcon™ has factored into some of the Rebel Alliance™ greatest victories over the Empire™. Before Han Solo™ won it in a game of chance, it was owned by Lando Calrissian™. Solo™ and first mate Chewbacca™ flew the Millennium Falcon™ into cinematic history.

name: AT-AT™
description: The All Terrain Armored Transport™, or AT-AT™ for short. They first appear in The Empire Strikes Back™. AT-AT™ walkers are 50 feet tall and have the appearance of a giant four-legged monsters. The head serves as the control center and a mount for the walker's weapons.

name: Darth Vader's TIE Advanced X1™
description: Darth Vader's TIE Fighter™ is the prototype that was used as the basis for all the terrifyingly effective TIE Fighters and Interceptors that would be developed for future battles. The TIE Fighter™ has proved itself in battle, as it is capable of withstanding many direct hits. In addition the pilots' chances of survival were considerably enhanced by the incorporation of a hyper drive system, which enables the ship to escape from hopeless battle situations.

name: Imperial Star Destroyer™
description: Designed to strike awe and terror into Rebel™ hearts, the Imperial Star Destroyer™ and the rest of the Empires fleet of space vessels maintain order in the galaxy through shows of power and ruthless fighting tactics. Is a capital ship. It first appears in the first seconds of Star Wars™ and is the signature vessel of the imperial fleet.

name: Destroyer Droid™
description: Destroyer Droids™, also known as Droidekas™, were used by the Trade Federation™ during the invasion of the planet Naboo™. These droids had shield generators and could curl into a ball for rapid movement.

name: TIE Fighter™
description: TIE Fighters are one-man starfighters with a spherical cockpit, hexagonal wings and two chin-mounted laser canons. The basic TIE fighter™ first appeared in A New Hope™ and is the primary Imperial fighter seen in the Original Trilogy.

name: X-Wing Star Fighter™
description: Is a starfighter from the original Star Wars™ trilogy and the expanded universe. They are depicted as the primary interceptor and dogfighter of the Rebel Alliance™ and the New Republic™.

name: Snowspeeder™
description: When stationed on Hoth™, the Rebel Alliance™ modified T-47 Air Speeder™ to become snowspeeders, fast flying conveyances for patrol and defense of their hidden base. It took some doing to keep the crippling cold from permanently grounding their air force, but Rebel ingenuity overcame the relentless Hoth™ elements. The T-47 Air Speeder™ is a small, wedge-shaped craft with two forward-facing laser cannons. In its rear arc is a harpoon gun fitted with a heavy-duty tow cable. The Snowspeeder™ is a two-man vessel, with a pilot and rear-facing tail gunner.

name: Imperial Shuttle™
description: An elegant example that stands apart from typical brutish Imperial engineering, the Lambda-class shuttle is a multi-purpose transport used in the Imperial Starfleet. The Empire pressed the shuttle into service for both cargo ferrying and passenger duty. Even the Empire's elite, like Darth Vader and the Emperor Palpatine used these shuttles. It has three wings: a stationary center foil and two articulated flanking wings. When in flight, the side wings fold out for greater stabilization. When landing, the wings fold in, shrinking the vessel's silhouette. The well-armed vessel has two forward-facing double laser cannons, two wing-mounted double cannons, and a rear-facing double laser cannon. It is equipped with a hyper drive.

name: Boba Fett's Starship™
description: The deadly ship was infamous for its association with Jango Fett, a bounty hunter in Mandalorian armor. Fett packed the craft with weapons, from laser cannons and projectile launchers to seismic charges. After Jango's death, Boba Fett refitted the ship and made it his own. A generation after his father's death, the distinctive craft remained the last thing fugitives wanted to see on their scanners.

name: AT-ST™
description: While not as imposing as its larger AT-AT walker cousin, the AT-ST nonetheless served as a significant addition to the Imperial side of battlefields in the Galactic Civil War. The two-man craft is lightly armed with chin-mounted laser cannons, and side-mounted weapon pods. The two-legged transport, dubbed the scout walker by many, serves as a reconnaissance and patrol vehicle, often flanking approaching AT-ATs and mopping up infantry that sneaks past the larger walkers. The Imperials used AT-STs in both the Battle of Hoth and the Battle of Endor.

name: Kylo Ren's Command Shuttle™
description: Kylo Ren's command shuttle was an Upsilon-class command shuttle utilized by Lord Kylo Ren™, who was a member of the Knights of Ren™ and the First Order™ around thirty years after the Battle of Endor™. The First Order’s top officers travel in Upsilon-class command shuttles that look like grim birds of prey. These ships’ massive wings are packed with defensive systems to protect their valuable passengers. The upper wings contain advanced sensor suites that scan for enemies, while the lower wings house efficient shield projectors and powerful jammers. Upon landing, the wings rise from flight mode and then retract, encasing the upper wings’ sensor arrays in thick armor.

name: First Order Special Forces TIE Fighter™
description: A two-seat strike fighter used by the First Order’s elite Special Forces pilots, the TIE/SF boasts weapons far more powerful than a standard TIE, combining laser cannons with a heavy turret and warhead launcher. Special Forces TIEs have hyperdrives, deflector shields and high-yield cells that provide additional power to onboard systems. These versatile attack ships are used for everything from reconnaissance to combat operations.

name: First Order Snowspeeder™
description: These speedy, versatile light utility vehicles are useful for a range of missions on the Starkiller Base™ and other frigid worlds. The First Order’s favored snowspeeder™ model is as simple as it is rugged: essentially a pair of seats, cargo platform, turbines and a deck-mounted repeating blaster.

name: Poe Dameron's X-wing™
description: The T-70 X-Wing Starfighter™ is an updated incarnation of the classic T-65B X-Wing Starfighter™ manufactured for use by the New Republic Starfleet. More expensive and complex than the former T-65B, the T-70 featured advanced weaponry and proved more versatile than its predecessor, and was essential in both dogfights and capital-ship scale combat operations. Appropriated S-foils designs allowed a greater range of fire, while four KX12 laser cannons offered single, dual, and quad firing modes. A built in dual proton torpedo launcher with quick-change magazines permitted the utilization of alternative armaments.

name: BB-8™
description: BB-8™, is a BB unit astromech droid who operated approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor™. It had a dome head, similar to that of R2 series astromech droids, with the bulk of its body made up of a ball on which the droid's head rolled. BB-8™ was mostly white, with some silver and orange on its body, as well as a black photoreceptor. The droid belonged to Resistance pilot Poe Dameron™, whom he accompanied during his flights on his T-70 X-Wing Fighter.

name: Enterprise NCC-1701™
description: The NCC-1701™ was a Federation Constitution class heavy cruiser that was in service with Starfleet in the mid to late 23rd century. In the course of her career, the Enterprise™ became the most celebrated starship of her time. The Enterprise™ was destroyed over the Genesis Planet in 2285 when Kirk activated the ship's auto destruct sequence o prevent the Enterprise™ from falling into the hands of the Klingons! Most famous Captain of the Enterprise™ was James T. Kirk™!

name: Gold USS Enterprise NCC-1701™
description: The NCC-1701™ was a Federation Constitution class heavy cruiser that was in service with Starfleet in the mid to late 23rd century. In the course of her career, the Enterprise™ became the most celebrated starship of her time. The Enterprise™ was destroyed over the Genesis Planet in 2285 when Kirk activated the ship's auto destruct sequence o prevent the Enterprise™ from falling into the hands of the Klingons! Most famous Captain of the Enterprise™ was James T. Kirk™!

name: USS Enterprise 1701-D™
description: The NCC-1701-D™ is a 24th century starship in the Star Trek™ fictional universe and the setting of the Star Trek: The Next Generation™ television series. It's a Galaxy class ship and the fifth Federation starship in the Star Trek™ universe to carry the name Enterprise™. In most of its service the commanding officer of Enterprise D™ is Captain Jean-Luc Picard™.

name: Bird of Prey™
description: The Bird of Prey™ is one of the most common Klingon™ Ships seen in the Star Trek™ Franchise.

name: Klingon Vor'Cha™
description: The Vor'Cha™ class attack cruiser is a powerful vessel that debuted in the Next Generation episode "reunion". It's combat role is stated to be comparable to that of a heavy cruiser.

name: Master Chief Helmet™
description: Trained from youth to be a sword wielded in the defense of humanity, Master Chief John-117 is a peerless master of warfare who has single-handedly saved Earth twice in recent memory. His skills honed over decades of combat operations on dozens of worlds, and his loyalty considered unshakeable, the Master Chief is a rock that enemies of mankind break themselves upon.

name: UNSC Warthog™
description: The Warthog is the UNSC's primary ground transportation vehicle, with the M12B Force Application Vehicle (FAV) serving as the most ubiquitous variant. Fitted with a full-rotation turret and heavy machine gun, the M12B FAV serves as a multi-role combat vehicle that can engage enemy light armor and aircraft with equal efficacy.

name: UNSC Pelican™
description: Available in a bewildering number of models and unique variants, the D-79 Pelican dropship is the UNSC’s most recognizable troop and materiel transport. These workhorse craft are equally at home in orbit and atmosphere, and have even been pressed into use for short interplanetary trips.

name: UNSC Mantis™
description: The Mantis is an all-environment bipedal walker used by the UNSC military. An evolution of earlier research and development involving military exoskeletons, the Mantis also integrates many technologies – such as shield generators and neural interface controls - created for the Spartans’ MJOLNIR power armor. The Mantis weapon package consists of a M655 20mm rotary autocannon and six-chamber M5920 rocket launcher.

name: Assault Rifle
description: The MA5D Assault Rifle is the latest model of Misriah Armory's famous MA5 Individual Combat Weapon System (ICWS) series. These exceptionally resilient, gas-operated, magazine-fed, automatic rifles are lethally efficient, regardless of hostile environmental conditions or duration of use in the field.

name: Forerunner Phaeton™
description: Compact, nimble, and bristling with firepower, the Phaeton gunship provides air support for Promethean forces. Employed in the billions during the Forerunners’ long, fruitless, war against the virulent Flood the Phaeton once again takes to the skies to strike against Covenant and UNSC forces.

name: UNSC Gungoose™
description: The M290-M “Gungoose” is the latest military version of the popular Mongoose all-terrain vehicle produced by AMG Transport Dynamics. Fitted with two grenade launchers, the Gungoose retains the Mongoose’s famous maneuverability while allowing for Spartan drivers to conduct harassing hit-and-run strikes.

name: UNSC Scorpion™
description: The Scorpion’s rugged, adaptable design has changed little from its origins at the dawn of human interstellar colonization. This vehicles has remained in service due a combination of affordability, simplicity, and versatility that is difficult to match by other – supposedly superior – designs. The Scorpion’s functional uses are numerous and varied, though the UNSC uses it predominantly for direct assault, localized defense, and anti-armor operations. The new M820 model of the storied Scorpion is half the mass of the old M808, yet has nearly identical firepower and armor protection.

name: Optimus Prime™
description: He lays his life on the line in the defense of his adopted world. Every action he takes, and every modification he makes to his formidable body, is done to protect Earth. Optimus is usually depicted as having rose up from the lowly worker to become a champion in gladiatorial combat.

name: Bumblebee™
description: Bumblebee™ has spent decades perfecting his fighting skills. With or without weapons, he is one of the most skilled fighters the Autobots™ have. He is dedicated to using his skills to defeat the Decepticons™, no matter where they appear. He is the little brother of the heroic or protagonistic Autobot™ faction and a mascot, constantly striving to prove himself in the eyes of the other robots-especially his leader, Optimus Prime™.

name: Gold Bumblebee™
description: Bumblebee™ has spent decades perfecting his fighting skills. With or without weapons, he is one of the most skilled fighters the Autobots™ have. He is dedicated to using his skills to defeat the Decepticons™, no matter where they appear. He is the little brother of the heroic or protagonistic Autobot™ faction and a mascot, constantly striving to prove himself in the eyes of the other robots-especially his leader, Optimus Prime™.

name: Soundwave™
description: Soundwave™ has spent centuries making himself indispensable to the Decepticon™ cause. His body is packed with electronic communications gear. He is capable of teasing even the faintest transmission out of the microwave background, cracking the toughest quantum code, and jamming the most powerful signal. Together with his minions, he is one of the most effective weapons in the Decepticon™ arsenal.

name: Megatron™
description: Is the founder of the Decepticon™ uprising, and their most well-known and feared leader. Megatron™ has lost battles, but he has never been truly defeated. Even after his near total destruction by the AllSpark™, he returned.

name: SX3 Alliance Fighter™
description: Systems Alliance frigates, named after the great battles of human history, are among the larger warships capable of traveling between star systems in the interactive world of Mass Effect. Smaller combat support craft, fighters, and interceptors are used in a support role to the warships during combat. Fighters are a one-man craft used to perform close-range attacks on enemy ships. One of these is the SX3 Alliance Fighter.

name: Normandy SR2™
description: Normandy is a Systems Alliance starship. She is a "deep scout" frigate, optimized for solo reconnaissance missions deep within unstable regions, using advanced stealth technology powered by an experimental drive core.

name: Turian Cruiser™
description: The turians are a race in Mass Effect, members of the Citadel Council and known for their military role, particularly their contribution of starships to the Citadel fleet.

name: Alliance Cruiser™
description: Alliance cruisers possess more firepower than a frigate and more maneuverability than a dreadnought and form the backbone of the Alliance fleet. They lead frigate "wolf pack" flotillas.

name: Boba Fett Helmet™
description: Boba Fett™ is a renowned bounty hunter in the Star Wars™ galaxy, known for his formidable Mandalorian™ armor and skills. He is an unaltered clone of Jango Fett™, raised as his son, and emulates his father's legacy. Boba Fett's career spanned the Galactic Republic™, Empire™, and criminal underworld, earning him a reputation as one of the galaxy's most feared hunters.

name: Mjolnir™
description: Thor's Hammer is a fictional weapon that appears in publications from the Marvel Comics™. It is the favored weapon of the superhero Thor™.

name: Captain America's Shield™
description: Is the primary defensive and offensive piece of equipment used by the Marvel Comic's Superhero Captain America™. He is seldom seen without it.

name: Iron Man™
description: Wounded, captured and forced to build a weapon by his enemies, billionaire industrialist Tony Stark™ instead created an advanced suit of armor to save his life and escape captivity. Now with a new outlook on life, Tony uses his money and intelligence to make the world a safe, better place as Iron Man™.

name: War Machine™
description: James Rhodes™ was a pilot in the U.S. Marines. He dons a modified version of the Iron Man™ armor given to him by Tony Stark™ and adopts the nickname War Machine™. The War Machine™ armor is built for combat.

name: Walt Disney World™ Main Entrance Sign
Batmobile™ (TV Series)
description: The 1966 Batmobile™ from the live action television show began life as a Ford concept car called the Lincoln Futura. The body of the Futura was fabricated by Ghia of Italy, whose artisans hammered the car's panels over logs and tree stumps carved as forms to create the sleek manta ray-like car. The extra-large bat-trunk in the Batmobile™ holds various crime-fighting equipment and has plenty of space to fit eight people comfortably. The windshield is bulletproof. And of course, the Batmobile™ is not without its helpful gadgets including the nose-mounted chain slicer, lasers, rockets, an on-board telephone, radar, dash monitor, on-board computer, and police beacon, among others.

name: Batmobile™ (1989)
description: The Batmobile™ is the Batman's primary mode of transportation. The vehicle is one of the most daunting components in his vast arsenal, keeping it stored in the Batcave™ when not in use. Affectionately dubbed the "Keaton-mobile" after Michael Keaton; the actor playing Batman™/Bruce Wayne™ in the films at the time, the car's popularity with fans has established a strong following and easily ranks with the 1966 Batmobile™ as one of the most popular Batmobiles of all time.

name: Batwing™ (1989)
description: The Batwing™ was Batman's custom-built air combat vehicle. The craft was fully armed with miniguns and missiles. It is unknown where the vehicle was stored, but it was presumably kept somewhere near the grounds of Wayne Manor™ or in the Batcave™. Although the notion of Batman™ possessing and flying a Bat-themed aircraft has been around in comics since 1939, the Batman™ 1989 film first introduced the classification of "Batwing". The movie's Batwing™ was also the first of any Bat-aircraft to be physically shaped after the bat-emblem to such a degree.

name: Bat-Signal™ (Classic)
description: The Bat-Signal™ is a distress signal device appearing in the various interpretations of the Batman™ mythos. It is a specially modified searchlight with a stylized symbol of a bat attached to the light so that it projects a large Bat emblem on the sky or buildings of Gotham City™. In the stories, the signal is used by the Gotham City™ Police Department as a method of contacting and summoning Batman™ to their assistance in the event of a serious crisis and as a weapon of psychological intimidation to the numerous villains of Gotham City™.

name: It's A Small World™ Trash Can
Tardis™
description: TARDIS™ (Time And Relative Dimension In Space) is a product of the advanced technology of the Time Lords. A properly maintained and piloted TARDIS™ can transport its occupants to any point in time and space. The interior of a TARDIS™ is much larger than its exterior.

name: Gold Dalek™
description: The Daleks are one of the most feared races in the universe. Their creator, Davros only has one intention, destroying all life apart from Dalek™ life. The Doctor has stopped them on several occasions but somehow they keep coming back!

name: Cyberman Head™
description: Cyberman™ originally born on Earth's twin planet Mondas, the Cybermen™ were created as the Mondasians replaced parts of their dying bodies with plastic and steel. Eventually they added emotional inhibitors, suppressing all feelings - love, hate, even fear.

name: K-9™
description: K-9™ was created by Professor Marius in the year 5000. The Doctor and his companion Leela helped Professor Marius defeat an alien virus. After the virus was defeated the professor asked if the Doctor to keep K-9™ and look after him.

name: Rusty K-9™
description: K-9™ was created by Professor Marius in the year 5000. The Doctor and his companion Leela helped Professor Marius defeat an alien virus. After the virus was defeated the professor asked if the Doctor to keep K-9™ and look after him.

name: Speeder Bike™
description: The Speeder Bike™ is a repulsor lift vehicle used for rapid reconnaissance and patrols, capable of high-speed maneuvers through dense terrain. Its lightweight frame and twin blaster mounts make it ideal for swift strikes and hit-and-run tactics. Commonly deployed by Scout Troopers™, its open design leaves riders exposed but allows for unmatched agility in forest or urban environments.

name: CAT Motor Grader™
description: Cat® Motor Graders have become the industry standard in operational efficiency and overall productivity. The motor grader is designed to help you build and maintain the haul roads needed to support maximum efficiency in large mining operations.

name: CAT Excavator™
description: The excavator is engineered for low operating costs, simple routine maintenance, high productivity and long-term durability. It incorporates innovations for improved performance and versatility.

name: CAT Wheel Loader™
description: Designed specifically to handle all the jobs on your worksite from material handling and truck loading, to general construction, to stockpiling. This machine is purpose-built to be just the right machine to get your everyday jobs done.

name: CAT Mining Truck™
description: Whether you’re hauling copper, coal, gold, iron ore or overburden the mining truck provides you with the best in class cost per unit of production. Including the improvements in safety, productivity, serviceability and comfort you will see why more mine sites choose it for their production needs.

name: CAT Dozer™
description: Engineered for demanding work. The dozer’s durable construction is made for tough working conditions. It keeps material moving with the reliability and low operating costs.

name: Hogwarts Express™
description: HOGWARTS EXPRESS™: Transports students to the Hogwarts Castle™

name: Rubeus Hagrid Hut™
description: HAGRID'S HUT: Services as the home to Rubeus Hagrid™ during his years as gatekeeper and teaching at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry™.

name: Golden Snitch™
description: The Golden Snitch™, is the third and smallest ball used in Quidditch™. It flies around the Quidditch™ field at high speeds. The Seeker's objective is to catch the Golden Snitch™ and win the Quidditch™ match.

name: Gringott's Dragon™
description: Also known as the Ukrainian Ironbelly species. Gringott's Dragon™ is used to guard several high-security vaults, including the Lestrange Vault, at Gringotts Wizarding Bank™.

name: F-14 Tomcat™
description: The supersonic F-14 Tomcat™ is a twin-engine, variable-sweep wing fighter aircraft. It was developed for the US Navy to counter Soviet MiG Fighter jets. The Tomcat is a two person crew consisting of a pilot in the front seat and a Radar Intercept Officer (RIO) in the back seat.

name: F/A-18 Super Hornet™
description: The F/A-18 Block III Super Hornet™ is the newest highly capable, affordable and available tactical aircraft in U.S. Navy inventory. The Super Hornet is the backbone of the U.S. Navy carrier air wing now and for decades to come.

name: S-97 Raider®
description: The fastest next-generation helicopter in the world, the Sikorsky® S-97 Raider® features twin four-blade contra-rotating main rotors and a rear pusher propeller, allowing for a top speed of 276 MPH. What makes the Raider even more unique is its ability to turn its rear propeller on and off for ''Whisper Mode'', allowing it to sneak up on targets.

name: Black Hawk®
description: Sikorsky® UH-60 Black Hawk® Since being introduced to the Army in 1979 this medium-lift, multi-role helicopter is now used in more than 28 countries world-wide. It has fought its way in and out of countless combat zones to deliver and extract troops, save lives, provide critical supplies and perform as an aerial firefighter and border patroller.

name: Samurai Armor (Naoe Kanetsugu)
description: This armor was worn by Naoe Kanetsugu (1559-1620), a famed Samurai Warrior. Naoe Kanetsugu was best known for his honor and well-respected judgment.

name: Mars Rover Perseverance & Ingenuity Helicopter
description: Perseverancelaunched July 30, 2020, enroute to Jezero Crater, Mars. Perseverance features a plutonium power source and a variety of instruments to aid the rover in its mission to seek signs of previous life on Mars, as well as collect data to further aid future manned missions there.Ingenuity, the 4 pound helicopter that was launched with Perseverance, features four specially made carbon-fiber blades, arranged into two rotors that spin in opposite directions at around 2,400 rpm – many times faster than a helicopter on Earth. It is a separate experiment from the rover and is intended to demonstrate technologies needed for flying in the Martian atmosphere.

name: Ford Trimotor™
description: Ford Trimotor™ was the world’s first luxury airliner when it took to the skies in the late 1920s. Nicknamed the “Tin Goose”, it featured an aluminum corrugated sheet-metal body and wings and was powered by three 420-hp Pratt & Whitney Wasp radial engines. Due to its rugged dependability Admiral Byrd chose it for his attempt to be the first person to fly over the South Pole, which he did on November 28, 1929.

name: LLV Mail Truck
description: Created for the United States Postal Service, the Grumman LLV is the most common delivery vehicle for postal deliveries in North America. Entering service in 1987, the LLV (Long Life Vehicle) can carry up to 1,000 lbs. of cargo.

name: Worldview Legion
description: The WorldView Legion satellites are built, owned and operated by Maxar. As six of them orbit our planet, they will capture satellite imagery with unprecedented precision, frequency and clarity.

name: James Webb Space Telescope
description: The James Webb Space Telescope, launched December 25, 2021, is the largest and most powerful telescope ever deployed. This $10 billion telescope was designed to collect light in the near-infrared spectrum which is the optimum wavelength to allow for the detection of very distant objects. In fact, the telescope allows astronomers to peer back in time to within 180 million years after the Big Bang which is even before the first galaxies formed!

name: P-51 Mustang
description: The North American P-51 Mustang is an American long‑range, single‑seat fighter and fighter‑bomber that played a crucial role in World War II by escorting bombers deep into enemy territory and helping achieve air superiority. It also served in the Korean War and continued in limited military use for years afterward.

name: AH-64 Apache™
description: The AH-64 Apache helicopter is a main attack helicopter designed and manufactured by Boeing for the U.S. Army, named after the Native American Apache tribe. It was developed under the U.S. Army’s Advanced Attack Helicopter program as the successor to the AH-1 Cobra.

name: Chime Bells from the Tomb of Marques Yi of Zeng State
description: 编钟，古代用青铜铸成的打击乐器，兴起于西周，盛于春秋战国直至秦汉。现有出土的文物里，曾侯乙编钟是中国迄今发现数量最多、保存最好、音律最全、气势最宏伟的一套编钟，代表了中国古代音乐的先进水平。它是国家一级保护文物，随着《国家宝藏》栏目的播出，再次走进人们的视野。拼酷携手物喜堂，经典复刻历史瑰宝，带你聆听穿越千年的浪漫回响。

name: Bronze Jin with Cloud Design
description: 云纹铜禁，春秋时期用以承放酒杯的青铜案台。“禁”有禁戒饮酒之意，用以警示人们，勿因嗜酒无度而酿成大祸。它的外形犹如一张玉床，四周盘龙踞虎，十二条龙形异兽面向禁的中心，探首吐舌，形成群龙拱卫的场面，令人叹为观止。它是国家的重要文物，2017年登上《国家宝藏》的舞台。拼酷携手物喜堂，用金属拼图复刻经典，焕发文物新活力。

description: 瓦西里大教堂又译圣瓦西里大教堂，位于莫斯科克里姆林宫外红场南端，是伊凡雷帝为纪念战胜蒙古侵略者而建，始建于公元1555年，公元1560年完成，是俄罗斯16世纪中后期建筑的主要代表。教堂建筑风格独特，其艳绝的色彩、无序的线条、葱头式穹窿尖顶都成为俄罗斯各地教堂的典范，充满童话色彩。

name: Saint Basil`s Cathedral
description: 瓦西里·柏拉仁诺大教堂始建于公元1555年，公元1560年完成。位于莫斯科克里姆林宫外红场南端，是俄罗斯中后期建筑的主要代表。16世纪中叶，伊凡雷帝为纪念战胜蒙古侵略者而建。建筑风格独特，内部空间狭小，着重外形，较像一座纪念碑，中央主塔是帐蓬顶，高47米，周围是8个形状色彩与装饰各不相同的葱头式穹窿。建筑用红砖砌成，以白色石构件装饰，大小穹窿高低错落，色彩鲜艳，形似一团烈火，具有强烈的节日气氛。建筑师是A·巴尔马和波斯尼克。

name: Violin
description: 小提琴（violin）是一种弦乐器。总共有四根弦。靠弦和弓摩擦发出声音。它广泛流传于世界各国，是现代管弦乐队弦乐组中最主要的乐器。它在器乐中占有极重要的位置，是现代交响乐队的支柱，也是具有高难度演奏技巧的独奏乐器。

name: Grand Piano
description: 三角架钢琴用于大型演出或专业人士。应用谱号：高音部：高音谱号，不移调记谱； 低音部：低音谱号，不移调记谱。 结构组成：由琴弦列、音板、支架、键盘系统（包括黑白琴键和击弦音棰）、踏板机械（包括顶杆 和踏板）和外壳共六大部分组成。

name: Harp
description: 竖琴（英：harp，意：Arpa，德：Harfe，波斯：چنگ），是一种大型弹弦乐器。竖琴是世界上最古老的拨弦乐器之一，起源于古波斯（伊朗）。早期的竖琴只具有按自然音阶排列的弦，所奏调性有限。现代竖琴是由法国钢琴制造家埃拉尔于1810年设计出来的，有四十七条不同长度的弦，七个踏板可改变弦音的高低，能奏出所有的调性。

name: Urheen
description: 二胡，汉族乐器。始于唐代，已有一千多年的历史。它最早发源于我国古代北部地区的奚人，那时叫奚琴。在过去它主要流行于长江中下游一带，所以又称为南胡。二胡是我国独具魅力的拉弦乐器。它既能表现深沉、凄惨的内容，也能描绘气势壮观的意境，音色接近人声，具有很高的情感表现力。

name: Record Player
description: 留声机是一种原始放音装置，其声音储存在以声学方法在唱片（圆盘）平面上刻出的弧形刻槽内。唱片置于转台上，在唱针之下旋转。留声机唱片能较简易地大量复制，放音时间也比大多数筒形录音介质长，因此，留声机被称为爱迪生最伟大的发明之一。

name: Mini Villa

description: 高跟鞋是让每个女性变美的灰姑娘的玻璃鞋，所以只要是女人就一定要学会穿高跟鞋，而且要走得轻盈亮眼，让人忍不住多看一眼！

name: Antique Agricultural Blower
description: 丰谷机是农村用来清除谷物中较轻杂质，如纰谷，杂草等的一种装置。有容器，出风口，手摇风扇，出口组成。使用时，把谷物放到容器中，出口接好盛谷物的容器，摇动手摇风扇，较轻杂质由出风口吹出，谷物流入盛谷物的容器。使用风谷机时，人禁止站在出风口，站在此处，杂物容易吹入眼睛。

name: Drum Set
description: 爵士鼓英文称作Drum kit或Drum set，集合许多打击乐器为一体，基本的组合包括了大鼓/地鼓（Bass Drum）、军鼓(Snare Drum）、嗵鼓（Tom Tom）、鼓/地嗵(Floor Tom）。镲片部分包括了脚踏钹/踩镲（Hi-Hat Cymbal）、重音镲/炸镲(Crash Cymbal)、节奏镲/叮叮镲(Ride Cymbal)。为了音色需要还可以加入中国镲(China)、水镲(Splash)、钟镲(Bell)。

name: Projector
description: 放映机是把影片上记录的影像和声音，配合银幕和扩音机等还原出来的机械设备。

name: M35 Military Motor Lorry
description: M35卡车是美国生产的军用卡车家族，授权生产多国，可载2300kg越野，公路运输可载4500kg货物，也有改装为武装卡车、车载防空炮、火力支援战车的M35A1等战斗车型。

name: Railway Gun
description: 卡尔600自行迫击炮，不是重型坦克，赛过重型坦克，有人称它为超级战车。1934年希特勒上台伊始，便积极扩军备战，为发动侵略战争做准备。为了能攻陷马洛奇防线一类坚固设防工事，希特勒对一些重型兵器青睐有加，重型迫击炮便是其中秘密武器之一。

name: 4WD Military Vehicle
description: 美国AMG公司以生产悍马（Hummer）而扬名世界。AMG公司的创始人乌特是一位自行车制造商，1903年成立越野（Overland）汽车部。1908年，约翰·威利购买了越野汽车部，并于1912年成立威利斯－越野（Willys－Overland）汽车公司，生产威利－骑士汽车。2009年，腾中重工从通用手中收购悍马，以失败告终。

name: IV Tank
description: Panzer-Ⅳ型坦克（德语全称为：Panzerkampfwagen IV），为纳粹德国二战中生成的一种中型坦克，大陆常称为四号坦克。它原本设计目的是支援步兵，并与专门执行反坦克任务的三号坦克协同作战。在三号坦克的整体性能逐渐不能满足二战中期装甲战斗需要时，四号坦克因所使用的技术较为成熟，并且有较大的改良空间，而被改造成主力突击坦克供给装甲师使用。二战期间，四号坦克先后生成过多种用途的改型战车，包括突击炮、自行反坦克炮、弹药运送车、架桥坦克等。因其可靠的性能和多样的用途，被德军士兵昵称为军马。

name: The Queen Anne
description: 安妮女王复仇号是一条海盗船，从前名叫协和号和南特的协和号。她壮观、美得惊人，是一只大海上野兽，这条扬名七海的传奇船只让公海上的海盗们感到心生恐惧。在开阔的海域快速切开一条通道，复仇号靠的是强大的防御力和致命的武器。据说安妮女王复仇号航行时满载着从不幸的受害者那里抢来的财富和宝藏。

name: Yellow Crane Tower
description: 黄鹤楼，国家5A级景点，享有天下江山第一楼、天下绝景之称。与晴川阁、古琴台并称武汉三大名胜。黄鹤楼位于中国湖北省武汉市长江南岸武昌蛇山峰岭之上，始建于三国时代吴黄武二年（公元223年），距今已有1780多年历史。唐时名声始盛，这主要得之于诗人崔颢昔人已乘黄鹤去，此地空余黄鹤楼诗句。

name: Yellow Crane Tower
description: 黄鹤楼，国家5A级景点，享有天下江山第一楼、天下绝景之称。与晴川阁、古琴台并称武汉三大名胜。黄鹤楼位于中国湖北省武汉市长江南岸武昌蛇山峰岭之上，始建于三国时代吴黄武二年（公元223年），距今已有1780多年历史。唐时名声始盛，这主要得之于诗人崔颢昔人已乘黄鹤去，此地空余黄鹤楼诗句。

name: The Flying Dutchman
description: 飞翔的荷兰人（德语：Fliegender Holländer；英语：The Flying Dutchman。又译作漂泊的荷兰人，彷徨的荷兰人，飞行的荷兰人等），是传说中一艘永远无法返乡的幽灵船，注定在海上漂泊航行。飞翔的荷兰人通常在远距离被发现，有时还散发着幽灵般的光芒。据说如果有其他船只向她打招呼，她的船员会试图托人向陆地上或早已死去的人捎信。在海上传说中，与这艘幽灵船相遇在航海者看来是毁灭的征兆。在德文里（fliegend）是用来表示一种持续飞行的状态，形容受诅的荷兰人永远飘流在海上，四处航行，却始终无法靠岸的悲惨宿命。

name: M2A2 - Bradley - IFV
description: 美国研制的一种步兵战车，它以美国五星上将布雷德利名字命名。布雷德利战车是一种履带式、中型战斗装甲车辆，可以独立作战，也可协同坦克作战，主要武器是一门25毫米机关炮，在炮塔还装有一挺并列机枪。布雷德利战车曾经两次出现在伊拉克战场并大显身手，为美军立下汗马功劳。

name: Classic Car
description: 老爷车，世界各地汽车爱好者对老式汽车的统一称谓，一般指二战前或更老的汽车。老爷车是一种怀旧的产物，但并不是每一辆旧汽车都有资格成为老爷车，保养完好是重要的先决条件，优良的设计，高标准的设计及制造工艺也是考量汽车价值的因素。目前关注老爷车的人越来越多，老爷车的身价也持续走高，老爷车收藏不仅具有娱乐放松和社交的功能，还蕴藏着获得投资回报的可能。

name: London Eye
description: 伦敦眼摩天轮也叫千禧之轮，坐落于泰晤士河畔，是英国为庆祝2000年的来临而建造的。摩天轮高135米，曾为世界之最，坐在上面可以俯瞰伦敦全貌，是伦敦的地标之一，也是伦敦最受欢迎的旅游景点。在夜间摩天轮会幻化成一个巨大的炫亮光环，宛如夜空中明亮的眼睛，大大增添了泰晤士河畔的梦幻气质，也给古老的伦敦带来新的活力。

name: Black Pearl
description: 被称为黑色的战舰，是影片《加勒比海盗》中的主角海盗船，是加勒比海上最快的船。全船结构设计合理，流线形的船身及巨大的动力使其速度极快，船上有大炮数门，火力强大。在那片叫加勒比的海域里，有一艘黑色的战舰，让所有敌人了解到冰霜的刺骨，当杰克船长和黑珍珠号合体的时候，诞生的就是霸气十足、前所未有黑珍珠号。

name: Motorcycle I
description: 一般指排量在400cc以上的摩托车。机车是台湾的说法，香港称为电单车，中国大陆地区称为摩托车。它由汽车驱动，靠手把操纵前轮转向的两轮或三轮车，轻便灵活，行驶迅速，广泛用于巡逻、客货运输等，也用作体育运动器械。骑行重型机车钱，一定要穿戴护具和安全帽以保障生命安全。

name: T-90A Tank
description: T-90A主战坦克：是俄罗斯研制的主战坦克，车体改良自T-72，早期的炮塔是与T-72类似的铸造炮塔，但后期的炮塔则是重新设计的焊接炮塔，火控则采用T-80U的火控系统。它主要为对付当时北约的威胁而研制，几乎全部都部署在西部军区和乌拉尔军区，一直作为俄罗斯本土的防御性武器使用，近几年才出口到印度。

name: Wuzhi-10 Helicopter
description: The Changhe Z-10, also known as the WZ-10, is a Chinese medium‑weight attack helicopter developed by the Changhe Aircraft Industries Corporation for the People’s Liberation Army. Designed primarily for anti‑armor warfare with secondary air‑to‑air capability, it first flew in 2003 and entered service in 2009. The helicopter features a tandem cockpit, stub wings for weapons, and advanced systems for close air support and battlefield interdiction.

name: Warrior
description: 大汉将军战甲：大汉将军，明代殿廷卫士的称号。锦衣卫所属曾编有大汉将军1500人，取身材高大者为殿廷卫士，以资壮观。另有红盔将军、明甲将军等，亦殿廷卫士称号。凡朝会及皇帝出巡，侍从扈行，宿卫则分番轮值。大汉将军战甲外形美观、穿着贴身、修补方便、综合防护能力强，是中式甲的典范。

name: Warrior
description: 大汉将军战甲：大汉将军，明代殿廷卫士的称号。锦衣卫所属曾编有大汉将军1500人，取身材高大者为殿廷卫士，以资壮观。另有红盔将军、明甲将军等，亦殿廷卫士称号。凡朝会及皇帝出巡，侍从扈行，宿卫则分番轮值。大汉将军战甲外形美观、穿着贴身、修补方便、综合防护能力强，是中式甲的典范。

name: Golden Rose
description: 玫瑰是蔷薇科蔷薇属植物，在日常生活中是蔷薇属一系列花大艳丽的栽培品种的统称。玫瑰果实可食，无糖，富含维他命C，常用语香草茶、果酱、果冻、果汁和面包等，玫瑰原产是中国。金玫瑰是一种黄铜工艺花，按照玫瑰花样式设计的金色玫瑰，花朵与叶是由黄铜材质做制，是一朵永不凋谢永不变形的花，象征爱情、亲情、友情的永恒。

name: BMPT Tank
description: BMPT装备了T-90型坦克的驱动系统，30毫米2A42型自动火炮，850发炮弹，Shturm-S型反坦克导弹，携带2000发子弹的新一代帘子线机枪和两挺30毫米AG-17D型榴弹发射器。BMPT在结构上实现了一体化火控系列配置，同时还装备有现代化热视仪、自动化消防系统、大规模杀伤性武器防护系统。最终军界人士给BMPT送了一个外号死亡联合收割机！

name: Racing Car
description: 方程式赛车：依照国际汽车联合会(简称FIA)制定颁发的车辆规则规定的方程式（包括车体结构、长度和宽度、最低重量、发动机工作容积、汽缸数量、油箱容量、电子设备、轮胎的距离和大小等）制造出来的赛车即为方程式赛车，所进行的比赛即方程式汽车赛，一级方程式世界锦标赛简称F1，是方程式汽车赛中最高级别的比赛。

name: Racing Car
description: 方程式赛车：依照国际汽车联合会(简称FIA)制定颁发的车辆规则规定的方程式（包括车体结构、长度和宽度、最低重量、发动机工作容积、汽缸数量、油箱容量、电子设备、轮胎的距离和大小等）制造出来的赛车即为方程式赛车，所进行的比赛即方程式汽车赛，一级方程式世界锦标赛简称F1，是方程式汽车赛中最高级别的比赛。

name: M2A3 - Bradley - IFV
description: M2A3步兵战车：M2A3步兵战车，是M2/M3系列步兵战车的最新改进车型，是美军最新型号的数位化骑兵战车，被称为数字化的布雷德利战车。它改进了射击控制装置、目标捕捉系统、导航系统和情况预警能力，能更有效的适应巷战环境，具有很强的资讯化作战能力。该车除了在美国本土服役外，还装备驻阿富汗、伊拉克以及韩国等地的美军部队。

name: Plan Liaoning CV-16
description: 辽宁号航空母舰：简称“辽宁舰”，以其改装所在地命名，是中国第一艘航空母舰。2015年9月5日正式交接入列，标志着我国实现航母“零”的突破，对于提高中国海军综合作战力量现代化水平、增强防卫作战能力，发展远海合作与应对非传统安全威胁能力，有效维护国家主权、安全和发展利益，促进世界和平与共同发展，具有重要意义。

name: Plan Liaoning CV-16
description: 辽宁号航空母舰：简称辽宁舰，以其改装所在地命名，是中国第一艘航空母舰。2012年9月25日正式交接入列，标志着我国实现航母零的突破，对于提高中国海军综合作战力量现代化水平、增强防卫作战能力，发展远海合作与应对非传统安全威胁能力，有效维护国家主权、安全和发展利益，促进世界和平与共同发展，具有重要意义。

name: Motorcycle II
description: 重型机车II：摩托车赛道上，从不乏惊险、刺激、疯狂，最快和最强是竞技摩托的目标，选择的机车当然也大有讲究。集强烈的前卫艺术设计、品质与外观造型的高度统一于一身，不仅性能卓越且外形炫酷，是这款重型机车II的重要特点。那流线型的整流罩、紧凑的结构、极具动感的车身，它停立在那里就带给人一种强烈的运动感。

name: Centurion AFV
description: 百夫长坦克：在第二次世界大战末期，英国开发了百夫长坦克作为其主站坦克。虽然在战争结束前有6辆原型车送到欧洲战场，可是并未赶上任何战斗。大战结束后，百人队长式坦克持续生产并且在英国皇军陆军服役。由于设计优良，受到其他国家的青睐，成为西方国家在二战之后服役国家最多的坦克，同时也是服役最久的坦克设计。

name: The Heart of Chechnya Mosque
description: 以车臣共和国首任总统艾哈迈德卡德罗夫的名字命名，是欧洲乃至世界最大的清真寺之一，可容纳上万人。该伊斯兰教建筑群的总占地面积为14英亩，旁边的夏季画廊和广场也能让万名信徒同时做祈祷。车臣之心周围矗立着四座尖塔（俄罗斯最高），高度为63米。土耳其大师用高品质的黄金在清真寺的墙体上绘制《古兰经》中的意象。

name: The Crossing
description: 是美国Manitowoc船厂制造的大湖型客货船，1920年下水，载重2050t。二战时作为美军的短程运输补给船使用。1948年7月被上海中联公司改成客船。1949年1月27日深夜，因超载、夜间航行未开航行灯等原因，从上海驶往台湾基隆的太平轮在嵊泗白节山岛附近海域沉没，是中国最大海难，上千人仅40人生还，堪称中国泰坦尼克号事件。电影《太平轮》正是根据这个故事改编而来。

name: Dinosaur Rock
description: 生性凶猛，体型庞大的洛克个性孤傲，不受命于任何束缚，藐视一切弱者和权威。洛克骁勇善战力量惊人，强壮坚硬的躯体是它强大战斗力的主要来源，坚实的头角，可以冲破任何建筑障碍，一切坚硬的东西在洛克锋利尖锐的牙齿下能被轻松撕碎。洛克全身厚实的机甲坚不可摧，可以在水底、沼泽、丛林等多种地形作战。

name: J20 Jet
description: The Chengdu J-20, nicknamed the 'Mighty Dragon', is a fifth-generation twin-engine stealth air superiority fighter developed by China’s Chengdu Aircraft Corporation for the People’s Liberation Army Air Force. It made its first flight in January 2011 and entered service in 2017, becoming one of the few operational stealth fighters in the world with advanced avionics, long-range capability and air-to-air combat focus.

name: J20 Jet
description: The Chengdu J-20 is a fifth-generation stealth fighter developed for the People’s Liberation Army Air Force. Entering service in the late 2010s, it features advanced avionics, stealth shaping, and long-range capabilities designed to enhance China’s air superiority and strategic reach.

name: The Travel of Hello Cool
description: 在呆萌可爱的外形下，机器人小酷有着一颗不羁的心，它乐观、洒脱、热爱自由，敢于去冒险，去探索生命中未知的旅途。随行的还有宠物狗——点点，一路耍贱卖萌，抛物拾取，围着小酷团团转，为旅途增添了莫大的乐趣。一个行李箱是它们的全部身外之物，它们勇闯天涯，写意人生，开启一场又一场说走就走的旅行。

name: Tengwang Pavillion
description: 滕王阁，江南三大名楼之一，位于江西省南昌市西北部沿江路赣江东岸，始建于唐朝永徽四年，因唐太宗李世民之弟...

name: Tornado Fighter Jets
description: The Panavia Tornado is a family of twin‑engine, variable‑sweep wing multirole combat aircraft developed and manufactured by a European consortium from the United Kingdom, Germany and Italy. First flown in 1974 and introduced into service in 1979–1980, the Tornado was designed for versatility in strike, interception and reconnaissance roles during the Cold War and saw service with several air forces through conflicts in the Gulf, the Balkans and the Middle East.

name: Dragon Flame
description: 爱好冒险，喜爱自由的烈焰飞龙，性格调皮。全身覆盖的厚实鳞片是它的保护伞及能量来源。尖锐的牙齿，强有力的四肢...

name: Dragon Flame
description: 爱好冒险，喜爱自由的烈焰飞龙，性格调皮。全身覆盖的厚实鳞片是它的保护伞及能量来源。尖锐的牙齿，强有力的四肢，灵活的龙尾，是它生活中强有力的武器；锋利的爪钩，愤怒时喷出的火焰，如蝙蝠翅膀般的巨翼，是它最大的亮点。它白天喜欢翱翔于高空，寻找地面上可一起玩耍的伙伴；夜晚则喜欢静静的立在悬崖边仰望辽阔的星空。

name: Knight of Firmament
description: 传说中，凌弓骑士以监管者和守护者的身份站在天国顶端，千年来，他遮住自己英俊的面孔，穿着巧匠氏族的唯一杰作...

name: Mayra
description: 电影《精灵王座》的大反派，她是女王的姐姐，因为她对黑暗力量过于痴迷而走火入魔。她对两块宝玉的渴望达到了极点...

name: Mayra`s Warship
description: 电影《精灵王座》大反派玫拉的战船。参考古代战船及一战时期的主力舰的冲角船艏，使其看上去更霸气，它的建筑...

name: The Watchtower of Forbidden City
description: 故宫角楼，传说灵感来源于一个蝈蝈笼子。它分别坐落在紫禁城的四个城角，与城垣及护城河同属于皇宫的防卫设施。每座角楼有九梁十八柱，七十二条脊，整体结构紧凑，红色与金色的搭配，凸显故宫角楼的雍容华贵。角楼设计比例和谐，大小结构复杂精密，别出心裁。檐角秀丽，造型玲珑别致，故成为紫禁城的标志。

name: The Monkey King
description: 孙悟空是中国著名的神话角色之一，出自四大名著之《西游记》。祖籍东胜神州，由开天辟地以来的仙石孕育而生，因带领群猴进入水帘洞而成为众猴之王，尊为美猴王。后历经千山万水拜菩提祖师为师学艺，得名孙悟空，学会地煞七十二变、筋斗云、长生不老等高超的法术。

name: M1A2 SEP TUSK II
description: M1A2艾布拉姆斯坦克每侧有7个铝制负重轮、1个诱导轮，1个主动轮和2个无轮缘托带轮，采用T156型双销挂胶履带，这些细节在模型上都清晰呈现出来。金色与银色的配合，让坦克更加炫酷有型。

name: SUV Off-Road Vehicle
description: 越野车的主要特点是四轮驱动，有着较高的底盘、较好抓地性的轮胎、较高的排气管、较大的马力和粗大结实的保险杠。

name: Black Knight
description: 黑骑士是电影《勇士之门》里的重要人物，正义至尊力量的神秘化身，面对现实与虚拟中的邪恶力量，奋勇战斗...

name: Artilleryman Style
description: 炮兵车STYLE：穿着铠甲的炮兵，既为他保留传统的服饰，又添加现代化的动作元素。侧屈腿半蹲，左臂向左前方伸展，左手食指和中指指向大炮发射的方向，右手握拳放于背后腰际。在他旁边放置着作战时需要用的大炮，大炮为笔架，共可放3支笔。拼装完成后的模型是桌面的精致摆件，既具有观赏性，又有实用性。

name: Crawler Crane
description: 履带式起重机是一种高层建筑施工所用，利用履带行走的动臂旋转起重机。它由动力装置、工作机构以及动臂、转台、底盘等组成。它的特点是操纵灵活，本身能回转360度，在平坦坚实的地面上能负荷行驶。由于履带的作用，可在松软、泥泞的地面上作业，且可以在崎岖不平的场地行驶。接地面积大，通过性好，可进行挖土、夯土、打桩等多种作业。

name: Merry Go Around
description: 旋转木马是游乐场机动游戏的一种，即旋转大平台上有装饰成木马且上下移动的座位供游客乘坐。旋转木马造型优雅，共两层，代表追求真爱与幸福。小马形态各异，动作生动，栩栩如生。多种颜色的采用让旋转木马还原度极高。传说旋转木马是个见证爱情的游戏，只要真心相爱的两个人坐在旋转木马上，木马就会载他们到幸福的地方，他们的爱情就会地久天长。

name: USS Enterprise CVN-65
description: “企业”号核动力航空母舰于1958年2月4日开始建造，服役于1961年11月25日，于2012年举行退役仪式。它是全世界第一艘使用核反应堆作为动力来源的航空母舰，也是美军第一代核动力航空母舰。企业号在美国海军服役51年，是海军在役时间最长的航空母舰，曾参加越南战争以及海湾地区多场战事和波黑战争，在其一生服役生涯中其足迹遍布全球。

name: Bismark Battleship
description: 俾斯麦号战列舰是以19世纪德国铁血首相奥托•冯•俾斯麦命名的超级战列舰，是第二次世界大战时德国所建造的火力最强的战舰。它曾一举击沉英国第一战列巡洋舰“胡德”号，是当时吨位最大、技术最先进的战列舰之一。其战舰性能非常优秀，不仅威力大，射速高，火力覆盖面积大，还可以高仰角对空射击，是当时德国海军的王牌。

name: Skynet Spider Superheavy Tank
description: P086-SGN 天蛛重型战车

name: The Colonel of Qin Empire
description: 秦朝时守护都城的重要武官，他身形强壮，威猛而健硕，为守护都城的安全始终如一的履行自己的使命。他有着非凡的军事本领，为保都城的安全亲自部署军事防护兵力，指挥着士兵突破敌人的进犯。手上的宝剑是他强有力的武器，挥剑成河，势将侵城的敌人一网打尽。背部披风大而飘逸，有着鲜明威武的气势，在气势上震慑敌人，更鼓舞着士气。

name: The Colonel of Qin Empire
description: 秦朝时守护都城的重要武官，他身形强壮，威猛而健硕，为守护都城的安全始终如一的履行自己的使命。他有着非凡的军事本领，为保都城的安全亲自部署军事防护兵力，指挥着士兵突破敌人的进犯。手上的宝剑是他强有力的武器，挥剑成河，势将侵城的敌人一网打尽。背部披风大而飘逸，有着鲜明威武的气势，在气势上震慑敌人，更鼓舞着士气。

name: Kizhi Church of the Transfiguration
description: 主显圣容大教堂是一个完全木质结构的教堂。位于俄罗斯卡累利阿共和国基日岛上，奥涅加湖的中央，距离首府彼得罗扎沃茨克68公里。主显圣容大教堂被收录在联合国教科文组织的世界文化遗产——它高37米、共22个圆顶叠摞在一起，这种颇具想象力的姿态，使参观者不禁为它的气魄感叹。

name: Yuewang Tower
description: 越王楼，位于四川省绵阳市龟山之巅，是唐太宗李世民第八子越王李贞任绵州刺史时所建，始建于唐高宗显庆年间，距今已1350余年，是与黄鹤楼、滕王阁、岳阳楼齐名的唐代文化名楼之一。又因其规模宏大、富丽堂皇，楼高十丈，时居四大名楼之首。富丽堂皇的越王楼吸引了千余年间的著名文人骚客登临，留下著名诗篇150多件，由此又被誉为“天下诗文第一楼”。

name: The Imperial Guards of Ming Dynasty
description: 前身为明太祖朱元璋设立的拱卫司后改称“亲军都尉府”，直接向皇帝负责。洪武十五年，改制锦衣卫。锦衣卫的主要职能是行侍卫、刑狱巡察缉捕之权。每逢皇帝朝会，祭祀外出巡游时，锦衣卫皆在身旁随时保护皇帝安全。他身穿飞鱼服、挂銮带头戴帽子、佩绣春刀，身材魁梧，整体形象威严而略带神秘感。他身形矫健，行动迅速每次任务都能及时快速地完成。

name: Nagato Class Battleship
description: 长门号战列舰于1916年完成初始设计，1920年11月25日完工交舰，服役时间长达20多年。该战列舰不仅拥有当时世界上最大口径的8门4座双联装410毫米舰载主炮，并且搭载有3架水上飞机，航速超过26节，而且根据海战经验，加强了重点区域的装甲防御，能防御远距离大角度落弹的打击。这重火力、高航速的战列舰被视为是当时世界上火炮威力最大，航行速度最快的战列舰。

name: Epang Palace
description: 阿房宫被誉为“天下第一宫”，是中国历史上第一个统一的多民族中央集权制国家——秦帝国修建的新朝宫，与万里长城、秦始皇陵、秦直道并称为“秦始皇的四大工程”。它始建于秦始皇三十五年，规模宏大，处处皆是朱甍碧瓦、飞檐卷翘，雕梁画栋，甚是辉煌。1961年，被国务院公布为第一批全国重点文物保护单位，1991年被联合国确定为世界上最大的宫殿基址，属于世界奇迹。

name: USS Missouri (BB-63)
description: 隶属于美国海军的战列舰，是美军第三艘以密苏里州命名的军舰，亦是美国海军最后一艘建成、二战最后一艘退役的战列舰。1941年于布鲁克林造船厂开始建造，是依阿华级战列舰，舰长270米，型宽32.9米，航速高达33节。它于1944年开始服役，在二战及朝鲜战争分别获得三枚及五枚战斗之星，因二战结束时被指派为受降舰而闻名于世，战后作为博物馆舰供世界游客参观。

name: Lucky Crane
description: 千纸鹤，一种纸折的工艺品，是美好祝愿的象征。传说，一天折一只千纸鹤，坚持一千天，就能给自己喜欢的人带来幸福，让其好运常伴、梦想成真。千纸鹤还常被视为爱情守护神，随身携带爱人赠送的千纸鹤，寓意非君不嫁、非卿不娶，一生一世矢志不渝。

name: Lucky Crane
description: 千纸鹤，一种纸折的工艺品，是美好祝愿的象征。传说，一天折一只千纸鹤，坚持一千天，就能给自己喜欢的人带来幸福，让其好运常伴、梦想成真。千纸鹤还常被视为爱情守护神，随身携带爱人赠送的千纸鹤，寓意非君不嫁、非卿不娶，一生一世矢志不渝。

name: Golden Rose (Blue)
description: 玫瑰，蔷薇科植物，枝干有边刺，花朵极为娇艳，且芬芳四溢，常被赋予爱的寓意，在希腊神话中，是爱与美的化身。玫瑰象征浪漫，情侣之间经常通过赠送玫瑰来传情达意，不同颜色，不同数量的玫瑰代表不同的含义。金色的玫瑰，代表高贵神圣，珍重祝福，而单支玫瑰的花语是“一生只爱一人”。为所爱的人献上金枝玫瑰，将所有的浓情蜜意交由花朵传达。

name: Golden Rose (Gold)
description: 玫瑰，蔷薇科植物，枝干有边刺，花朵极为娇艳，且芬芳四溢，常被赋予爱的寓意，在希腊神话中，是爱与美的化身。玫瑰象征浪漫，情侣之间经常通过赠送玫瑰来传情达意，不同颜色，不同数量的玫瑰代表不同的含义。金色的玫瑰，代表高贵神圣，珍重祝福，而单支玫瑰的花语是“一生只爱一人”。为所爱的人献上金枝玫瑰，将所有的浓情蜜意交由花朵传达。

name: Golden Rose (Red)
description: 玫瑰，蔷薇科植物，枝干有边刺，花朵极为娇艳，且芬芳四溢，常被赋予爱的寓意，在希腊神话中，是爱与美的化身。玫瑰象征浪漫，情侣之间经常通过赠送玫瑰来传情达意，不同颜色，不同数量的玫瑰代表不同的含义。红色的玫瑰，代表热力四射、为你心动，而单支玫瑰的花语是“一生只爱一人”，为所爱的人献上金枝玫瑰，将所有的浓情蜜意交由花朵传达。

name: Leifeng Pagoda
description: 雷峰塔又名皇妃塔、西关砖塔，位于浙江省杭州市的雷峰上，是吴越忠懿王钱弘俶因黄妃得子而建的佛塔。雷峰塔是中国造塔历史上的一座艺术精品，首创八角形平面，尺度雄伟，美轮美奂，有着极高的艺术价值和历史文化价值。它还被作为重要元素写入脍炙人口的民间故事《白蛇传》中。旧雷峰塔已于1924年倒塌，而新建的雷峰塔是中国首座彩色铜雕宝塔。

name: Battleship Yamato
description: “大和号”是第二次世界大战中的日本帝国海军建造的大和级战列舰的一号舰，是人类历史上最大的战列舰，曾号称“世界第一战列舰”、“日本帝国的救星”。战舰长263米，宽38.9米，满载排水量72808吨，航速可达27节。“大和号”的舰首呈球形，拥有大口径主、副炮20余门，装甲厚、防护能力强，即使同时命中2条鱼雷或数枚重磅航弹也不影响战斗。

name: Colorful Peacock
description: 孔雀是百鸟之王，雀冠挺立，羽翼斑斓，高贵优雅，开屏时尾巴如同一把镶满宝石的扇子，艳丽夺目。传统文化中，它是祥瑞的象征，孔雀开屏，财运滚滚；孔雀叼花，富贵荣华；孔雀入巢，时来运转；孔雀跳舞，喜从天降！由于孔雀姿态唯美，舞蹈家以其为灵感创作出《孔雀》、《雀之灵》、《雀之恋》等深入人心的舞剧。

name: Lucky Pigsy
description: 八戒，法号悟能，是《西游记》中唐僧的二徒弟，与孙悟空、沙僧一起保护唐僧西天取经，最后被封为净坛使者。他精通三十六变，能腾云驾雾，其专属武器为太上老君所造、玉皇大帝亲赐的上宝沁金耙，俗称九齿钉耙。由于外形憨厚老实，个性耿直率真，风趣幽默，心宽体胖，所以深受普罗大众的喜欢。他虽然表面笨拙，却是大勇若怯，大智若愚的代表。

name: The Holy Monk of Tang
description: 大唐圣僧，其原型是《西游记》中家喻户晓的唐僧，法号“玄奘”，被尊称为“三藏法师”。为了弘扬佛法，普度众生，他和孙悟空、猪八戒、沙僧三个徒弟一起西天取经。一路上，他慈悲为怀，传播禅道；乐善好施，为民解忧；意志坚定，不被各路妖魔迷惑。最后，凭借执着的追求，历经九九八十一难，取得真经，成为人人敬仰的得道高僧。

name: Mu Guiying
description: 穆桂英，中国古代杰出的巾帼英雄，因精忠报国而声名显赫。作为杨门女将，她赤胆忠肝，一心报国。天门阵险象环生，她英勇挂帅，深入险境，痛歼辽军；南方叛乱，她红颜裹戎装，血战疆场，立下赫赫战功；丈夫西征受困金山，她五十三岁犹挂先锋印，力战番将，最后为国壮烈捐躯。穆桂英一生鞠躬尽瘁，保家卫国，成为后世歌颂的典范。

name: Yang Zongbao
description: 杨宗保，杨家将之一，中国古代精忠报国的代表。他少年即随父四处征战，屡建战功，受世人敬仰，民谚中流传着“少年要比杨宗保”的说法。辽军入侵，他和妻子穆桂英齐心协力，大破天门阵，保卫宋朝疆土；南方叛乱，他征战沙场，保护百姓安宁；西夏进犯，他冲锋陷阵，英勇牺牲。其爱国精神和民族情怀，感人肺腑，被传颂至今。

name: Auspicious Kirin
description: 麒麟，中国传统瑞兽，与凤、龟、龙合称“四灵”，传说能活两千年，是祥瑞、太平、长寿的象征。它集狮头、鹿角，虎眼、麋身、龙鳞、牛尾于一体，口中能喷出火焰，咆哮如雷鸣，威风凛凛，气势凶猛。麒麟在中国传统文化中有着深厚内涵，民间流传着“麒麟送子”，“麒麟踏祥云，人间百难消”的说法，所以麒麟常被制成饰品、摆件用于佩戴或安置家中，以祈求安康。

name: Hall of Supreme Harmony
description: 太和殿，俗称金銮殿，是中国古代宫殿建筑的精华，东方三大殿之一，也是中国现存最大的木结构大殿。它位于北京紫禁城南北主轴线的显要位置，是紫禁城内规模最庞大、等级最高、体量最大的建筑，主要用于举行盛大典礼，如皇帝登基、皇帝大婚等。大殿内外装饰华丽，金碧辉煌，殿前有宽阔的月台，殿内装饰是汉族宫殿建筑史上之最，彰显了其至高无上的地位。

name: Guanque Tower
description: 鹳雀楼，又名鹳鹊楼，位于山西省黄河东岸，因时有鹳雀栖息在上而得名。它是现存最大的仿唐建筑，也是国家级4A旅游景区，外部四檐三层，内分六层，结构设计精妙不凡。鹳雀楼始建于北周，地理位置优越，四周风景秀丽，曾吸引众多文人墨客登楼赏景，留下大量不朽诗篇。其中“白日依山尽，黄河入海流。欲穷千里目，更上一层楼”，就是唐朝才子王之涣登鹳雀楼时写下的千古名句。

name: Russian Battlecruiser Pyotr Velikiy
description: 彼得大帝号是俄罗斯海军的核动力导弹巡洋舰，是苏联1144型（北约称：基洛夫级）巡洋舰的4号舰，被称为前苏联海军的巅峰之作，具备当时最先进、最完整的作战系统。它全长252米，宽28.5米，标准排水量19000吨，满载排水量24300吨，是世界上吨位最大的非航空母舰战斗舰艇，也是世界上唯一现役的非航空母舰核动力水面作战舰艇，主要用于实施远洋反舰、反潜和防空作战。

name: Juyuan Tower
description: 聚远楼历史悠久，始建于宋熙宁二年（1069年），与黄鹤楼、岳阳楼、滕王阁并称“江南四大名楼”，是中国传统建筑的重要瑰宝。它坐落于江西省德兴市，因登楼远眺，可将全城美景尽收眼底，故取名为聚远楼。著名文豪苏轼曾登楼游览，写下《题咏聚远楼诗》，广传天下，建炎年（1127年），宋高宗深赏此诗，特赐“聚远楼”金匾。才子作诗，皇帝赐匾，聚远楼一时名扬天下。

name: HMS Prince of Wales
description: 威尔士亲王号战列舰，乔治五世国王级战列舰的二号舰，是二战时期英国海军主力战列舰之一。它始建于1937年，长227.1米，宽31.3米，满载排水量达40580吨。1941年，在拦截任务中，与德国俾斯麦号交手，相互重创。1941年8月，《大西洋宪章》在该舰上签订，标志英、美形成反法西斯联盟。1941年12月10日，在马来海战中，它被日空军击沉，结束了短暂而又不平凡的服役生涯。

name: The God of Fortune
description: 财神，主管世间财源的神明，它倾注了中国劳动人民的朴素情感，寄托着安居乐业，迎祥纳福的美好愿望。每逢春节，家家户户都会悬挂财神像，希望财神保佑，富贵临门。正月初五，民间还有接财神的习俗，人们相信把财神请进家，来年可以财源广进，一帆风顺。日常生活中，人们也会在家摆放财神像，祈求纳福镇宅。

name: Golden Toad
description: 金蟾，又称三足金蟾，是能够口吐金钱的瑞兽，在刘海戏金蟾的传说中，它被赋予招财进宝，财源广进的美好寓意。在民间，流传着“得金蟾者必大富”的俗语，人们相信金蟾能够带来滚滚财源。摇钱树是凝聚天地精华的宝树，树上金钱取之不尽，用之不竭。在堪舆学中，金蟾和摇钱树组合到一起，象征带来双倍的财富，放在家居或商铺的财位，有奇妙的作用。

name: Phoenix Coronet
description: 凤冠，是以金属丝网为胎，上缀点翠凤凰，并挂有珠宝流苏的礼冠。其造型极其华美，嵌有珍珠、宝石、翡翠等珍贵珠宝，唯美大气，绚丽夺目，非一般尊贵。它象征了祥瑞、希望和幸福，承载了人们喜结良缘，百年好合的美好愿望，是许多女子的一生期待。女子出嫁时，头戴凤冠，身穿霞帔，脚踏红绣鞋，满身喜庆，以最美的姿态迎接人生的重要时刻。

name: Bridal Sedan Chair
description: 花轿，也称喜轿，其造型精美，装饰华丽，常以朱漆铺底，并用金箔贴花，通体雕刻着精致的花纹，金碧辉煌，奢华气派。轿身常饰有红绸缎做成的轿衣，上绣百年好合、龙凤呈祥等喜庆图案，寓意爱情甜蜜，幸福一生。花轿是传承千年的中式婚庆文化，女子一生只能坐一次。结婚坐花轿，对女子来说是一生最幸福最美好的时刻。

name: Garuda
description: 传说有一鸟，名金翅大鹏，他金翅鲲头，星睛豹眼，利爪如刃，一个振翅就是九万里，行动起来天地变色。大鹏欲吃唐僧肉，与孙悟空斗法，悟空不敌，请求如来佛祖帮忙。如来施法将其收服并留在身边当护法，此后，金翅大鹏便陪伴如来左右，普度众生。所以人们相信，用金翅大鹏的摆件装点空间，有镇宅避邪、护佑平安的作用。

name: Scarlet Macaw
description: 金刚鹦鹉，脸上布满条纹，像京剧中的脸谱，兴奋时会变红，身上的羽毛色彩缤纷，艳丽夺目，具有很高观赏价值。它聪明伶俐，会说话唱歌，深得大众喜欢，不少人还把它当做宠物饲养。鹦鹉，谐音“英武”，有生机勃勃，欣欣向荣之意；成双成对，又寓意爱情幸福，家庭和睦；因寿命长，又象征着长寿健康。充满吉意的鹦鹉，还常被制成摆件装点家居。

name: The Black Dragon
description: 黑龙王，大地的守护者，也是黑龙族的领主，它沉着冷静、聪明睿智并且拥有强大的力量。它体格强壮，四肢发达，背部巨大的双翼，是其标志性特点。全身遍布的龙鳞，是它坚固的铠甲，锯齿状的牙齿、锐利的爪子、灵活的尾巴，让其所向披靡。霸气威猛的它，曾在知名游戏中出现过。

name: Book End of Dragon Gate
description: 中国古代有四大神兽，朱雀、玄武、青龙、白虎，它们分别镇守南北东西四个方位。青龙为东方之神，体相威武，人们认为有趋吉避凶的作用，常被刻画在宫阙、殿门、城门等地方。风水学中，在建筑左侧开门叫青龙门，有利于聚集地气、催运生财、纳福添喜。将青龙门做成书靠，不仅实用美观，还有学业进步、学有所成、步步高升的美好寓意。

name: The Princess Carriage
description: 公主马车，西方贵族所使用的交通工具，造型华丽，高贵优雅，被誉为“车轮上的宫殿”，是庄严、权力和财富的象征。在英国皇室婚礼中，马车巡城是一直保留的传统，王子和公主会在马车上接受大众的祝福。马车还常常出现在童话故事中，是浪漫、幸福的象征，每个女生都期待自己可以成为童话中的公主，坐着马车遇见仙履奇缘。

name: Princess Jasmine
description: 在宏伟的城堡中，住着一位美丽的茉莉公主，她聪明、勇敢、善良、活泼，对生活充满爱与期待。她喜欢冒险，喜欢探索世界，脑海里时常有着天马行空的想象。伴随着欢快的音乐，和茉莉公主一起出发吧，去看星辰大海，去看绿野森林，在童话般的旅途中，邂逅奇妙的梦中奇缘！

name: Queen Ruyi
description: 如懿，原名青樱，与弘历（即乾隆）二字相对，有“青樱红荔”之美意。她是大清皇后，性情直爽，深情专一，温柔而坚韧。她与乾隆青梅竹马，相知相爱，一生钟情不悔。她对爱情的执着，如同冬日的烈火，温暖人心。转动音乐盒，在悠扬的旋律里，细细聆听道不尽的柔情蜜意。

name: Emperor Qianlong
description: 乾隆，大清皇帝，勤政爱民，励精图治，开创了乾隆盛世。他原名爱新觉罗·弘历，与青樱（即如懿）二字相对，有“青樱红荔”之美意。他与如懿青梅竹马，相知恩爱，是一对名副其实的才子佳人。两人甜蜜的青葱时光，是他一生难忘的幸福回忆。转动音乐盒，在悠扬的旋律里，感受幸福甜蜜的心情。

name: Wenchang Tower
description: 文昌塔，又称文峰塔、文笔塔，是人们心中神圣的宝塔。历史上，建有文昌塔的地方，常有才俊高中科举，金榜题名，因此人们相信它能聚集灵气，福佑学业。文昌的名称源于“文曲星”和“文昌帝君”，代表旺文，在堪舆学中有催文催贵作用。拼酷文昌塔，是催旺学业、功名、事业的吉祥物，将其放在文昌位，有助于学业进步，官运亨通。

name: Fuso Battleship
description: 日本海军扶桑级战列舰的1号舰，日本独自设计的第一只超弩级战舰。它建于吴县海军造船厂，竣工时，是当时世界上排水量、兵装、舰型最大的战舰。它于1915年11月18日开始服役，该舰舰长205米，型宽28.65米，满载排水量38,536吨，航速24.7节，装有12门双联装356毫米主炮，16门152毫米副炮等火力设备。1944年莱特湾海战，扶桑号在作战过程中遭受美国海军攻击，于10月25日沉没。

name: Kongou Battleship
description: 金刚号是日本金刚级战列巡洋舰的1号舰，活跃于二战时期的太平洋战场。历经两次改造，它成为当时日本航速达到30节的战列舰。它的舰长有222米，型宽有31.7米，并配备8门双联装356毫米主炮；14门152毫米副炮等设备。在莱特湾海战中，击沉美国甘比尔湾号航空母舰和一艘驱逐舰，是它服役生涯中的辉煌战绩。

name: Tang Paradise
description: 芙蓉园，唐朝时期的皇家禁苑，园内宫殿连绵，楼亭起伏，紫云楼、彩霞亭、临水亭等韵味建筑应接不暇，是皇家贵族的游览胜地。它位于景色秀丽的曲江，原为秦王朝所建的宜春苑，隋唐时期更名为芙蓉园并加以扩建，园内景观尽显盛唐风采。每逢曲江大会，唐明皇会携嫔妃百官，登临芙蓉园与民同乐，万人空巷的盛况非同一般。

name: Wedding Bed
description: 民国初期，浙江张府富甲一方，家中有一小姐，从小视如珍宝。待其即将出嫁，家人掷千金，广纳能工巧匠，打造一张奢华婚床作为嫁妆。该床耗费一千工时完成，因此得名千工床，其做工精致，繁复中见巧智，奢华中带雅致，朱金木雕、螺钿镶嵌、错彩镂金、富丽堂皇。此事被流传为佳话，后人纷纷效仿，给新人送婚床，祝福他们琴瑟和鸣，幸福美满。

name: Wedding Dress
description: 大明年间，霓裳阁以制衣工艺闻名全国，不仅给贵族定制服饰，还给皇宫特供霓裳。其阁主深爱未婚妻，大婚前为她定制了一套精妙绝伦的嫁衣，一时轰动全城。该嫁衣由多名刺绣大师联合制成，以红色锦缎为底，上锈凤凰于飞，下纹海水江崖，边缘点缀金纹，裙摆及地三尺，摇曳生姿，美轮美奂。凤冠霞帔，十里红妆，是对爱情最美的承诺。送一件嫁衣给爱人，许她一生情深不渝。

name: Palace Lantern
description: 明初，有一秀才高中状元，皇帝欲招为驸马，状元却请求赐婚寒窗苦读时陪伴左右的姑娘。皇帝被他不忘初心的诚意打动，不仅同意赐婚，还命人打造一盏鎏金宫灯，赐给这对佳偶，寓意明灯高照，前程似锦，幸福相守。这盏宫灯雕龙画凤，镶银嵌宝，绘有花鸟、瑞兽、美人图，巧夺天工，美轮美奂。后民间流传，喜结良缘，高悬宫灯，代表相濡以沫，执手白头的祝福。

name: Er-Lang God
description: 二郎神，又名杨戬，在《西游记》、《封神演义》、《聊斋志异》等文学作品中均有出现。他是玉皇大帝的亲外甥，却在人间长大。为劈山救母，他拜师学艺，踏遍五湖四海寻求巨力宝物开山斧，最终如愿劈开桃山，与母亲团聚。二郎神武功绝伦，力大无穷，拥有七十二变的不凡法力；三尖两刃枪和额间的第三只神眼是他的标志。

name: Merry Go Around
description: 旋转木马，会伴随欢快的音乐旋转和上下移动，充满梦幻的气息。它是很多人的童年印象，也是很多人的爱情回忆，象征美好和幸福。传说，相爱的人坐上旋转木马，爱情就能天长地久。将旋转木马做成可拼装的八音盒，把一拼一折的心动化成爱的乐章，为你纪念难忘的时光。

name: Tian`anmen Rostrum
description: 天安门，位于首都北京市中心，其名涵盖了“承天启运、国泰民安”的寓意，迄今屹立六百多年，见证了许多历史大事件，在我国人民中具有不凡的地位和意义。1949年10月1日，开国大典在此举行，天安门因此被设计入国徽，并成为中华人民共和国的象征。此外，作为十多次大阅兵的举办地，它见证了一次次科技的飞越，见证了我国国力的不断壮大。

name: King Kong
description: 金刚，南天门的守护神，和擎天一起维护天庭入口的秩序。他有卫家宅、保平安、助功利、降吉祥的寓意，能给人们带来祥瑞。其造型新颖独特，盔甲和机械精妙融合，玄黄和银白碰撞，耀眼夺目。他凛然站立，目视前方，手握锥刺，英勇神武，仿佛从天而降的天将，非常适合守护家宅。

name: Titan
description: 擎天，南天门的守护神，和金刚一起维护天庭入口的秩序。他有卫家宅、保平安、助功利、降吉祥的寓意，放于家中相当吉利。擎天的造型新颖，盔甲和机械精妙融合，兽吞元素巧妙应用，硬核又霸气。看他身披紫蓝色战甲，手握神兵利器，四周祥云腾绕，定是镇宅招福的好能手。

name: Southern Gate
description: 南天门，天庭的正门，曾出现在《西游记》、《封神演义》、《白蛇传》、《哪吒闹海》等神话故事中。传说，它是人界通往仙界的入口，常有天兵天将镇守保护，所以人们相信，跨越它即通往幸福。拼酷南天门，宏伟大气，祥瑞不凡，放于家宅不仅可装饰空间，更有去除水逆，福佑平安的寓意。

name: Dancing Lion (Gold)
description: 醒狮，传统舞狮的一种，流行于岭南地区，每逢喜庆节日，或重大活动，常会以醒狮助兴。采青是醒狮的精髓，人们在高处悬挂“吉利物品”，醒狮去采摘，代表财源滚滚，金玉满堂。一般醒狮会有两只或以上，寓意好事成双，喜事不断。2006年5月20日，醒狮被列入第一批国家级非物质文化遗产名录。醒狮拼图，传承文化精髓，向你传递美好的祝愿。

name: Dancing Lion (Red)
description: 醒狮，传统舞狮的一种，流行于岭南地区，每逢喜庆节日，或重大活动，常会以醒狮助兴。采青是醒狮的精髓，人们在高处悬挂“吉利物品”，醒狮去采摘，代表财源滚滚，金玉满堂。一般醒狮会有两只或以上，寓意好事成双，喜事不断。2006年5月20日，醒狮被列入第一批国家级非物质文化遗产名录。醒狮拼图，传承文化精髓，向你传递美好的祝愿。

name: The Moon Palace
description: 广寒宫，又名月宫，神话中位于月亮上的宫殿，为嫦娥所居。它是一个宫殿群，琼楼玉宇座座相连，缕缕烟波缠绕其中，如梦似幻。相传，嫦娥吃了仙丹之后，因不舍后羿，便居住在离地球最近的广寒宫。每年八月十五，后羿做月饼，放在屋子西北方向，连续呼唤嫦娥的名字，两人便能团圆。后来，“嫦娥奔月”“后羿做饼”的故事就这样在民间流传。

name: Pawn Shop
description: 唐朝时期，集市的发展已经相当成熟，商铺林立、紧紧相依，形成纵横交错的繁华小街。当铺就在大唐小街里，人们有困难或急需用钱，会拿各种物品来抵押，换取周转资金。拼酷当铺的设计融合了盛唐的建筑特色，古色古香，华美瑰丽，原汁原味地再现当时的生活风貌。除此之外，更有胭脂铺、风满楼等系列建筑，带你领略繁华的盛唐气象。

name: Restaurant
description: 风满楼，唐朝时期的酒楼，每天客似云来，人声鼎沸，在川流不息的集市里，尤为热闹。兰陵酒是这里的招牌美酒，琼浆玉液、酒香四溢，闻名天下，众多爱酒之人慕名而来。风满楼共有三层，气派俊美，飞檐翘角、碧阑轩窗，淋漓尽致地展现了盛唐特色。它和当铺、胭脂铺等建筑组合到一起，将带你感受千年前的繁华闹市。

name: Rouge Shop
description: 在热闹繁华的集市里，有一个典雅俏丽的建筑，里面的胭脂水粉各式各样，琳琅满目，让人应接不暇。这间颇受女子欢迎的胭脂铺，和周围的酒家当铺略有不同，色彩艳丽却不失典雅，让人眼前一亮。它的细节精湛，雕窗里牡丹花开，飞檐上灯笼高挂，尽显盛唐风韵。来收藏一套胭脂铺、风满楼等唐风建筑吧，在拼装的世界中感受古人的惬意生活。

name: Chang`an Archway
description: 牌坊，中国传统建筑，用于功勋表彰或作地标建筑，常见于园林、寺观、宫苑、街道等地方。长安街牌坊位于街道的重要位置，人们进出都要经过这里。它恢弘大气，从遥远处就能感受其气派，飞檐翘角，瑞鹤祥云，蕴含着浓郁的民族特色。它和当铺、胭脂铺等建筑组成的“大唐小街”系列拼图，将从微观世界里带你开启盛唐之旅。

name: Datang Street Scene Set
description: 大唐小街系列是根据唐代闹市打造的拼图，古风建筑鳞次栉比、繁华街道车水马龙，生动地展现了那个时代的生活风貌。这个场景套装，包含了除建筑以外的场景配件，有璀璨的彩灯、行走的马车、各式各样的行人、充满烟火气的馄饨摊等。它们不仅可以搭配大唐小街的建筑，还可以搭配其他古风建筑，快来发挥你的想象力，搭建自己的古风世界吧！

name: Shufeng Escort
description: 古时候交通不便，长途出行艰辛且不安全，于是诞生了专门保护财物或人身安全的镖局。顺丰镖局就坐落在大唐小街，它的造型气派，门侧伫立两个大鼓，威武庄严；庭院宽敞开阔，落兵台上摆着大刀长枪，常有镖师拿去习武；主楼高台累累，镖旗迎风飘扬，颇有一番气势。它和当铺、胭脂铺等系列建筑，将为你呈现繁华的大唐盛景。

name: Red Crabapple Theater
description: 海棠红戏院，是专门表演戏剧的地方，也是旧时候的传统娱乐场所。这里每天都会上演精彩绝伦的戏曲剧目，吸引一大批观众驻足观看，每到节假日，就更为热闹，台上精彩不断，台下宾客满座，熙熙攘攘，笑声、掌声、喝彩声响成了一片。惟妙惟肖的金属拼图，将带你“走进”传统戏院，听一曲回味无穷的戏曲，领略中华国粹之美。

name: Black Pearl (Color)
description: 黑珍珠号是电影《加勒比海盗》中的主角船，也是加勒比海上最快的船。船体结构设计精妙，流线形的船身和强大的动力使其快速前行，让它能神不知鬼不觉地到皇家港口进行攻击。它火力强大，经历传奇，曾和荷兰人号正面交锋，也在危难关头救起了困在海中的杰克等人。特别版的黑珍珠海盗船金属拼图，造型精致，色彩丰富，更具观赏和收藏价值！

name: Courtyard House
description: 四合院，一种传统的合院式建筑，拥有3000多年历史，是中国传统文化的象征。其格局为四面房屋将庭院合围在中间，寓意圆满和谐，结构呈中心对称，体现了阴阳五行学说。在绿树掩映的街巷里，四合院散发着独特的历史风韵和东方风情，将时光里的故事娓娓道来。来拼一个四合院金属拼图，于方寸之间塑一隅东方印象。

name: Dragon Gate Carps
description: 鱼跃龙门源于中国传统神话故事，黄河锦鲤逆流而上，在龙门前纵身一跃，化身为龙，身价百倍。它代表着逆流前进、奋发向上、事业成功和地位高升，寄托了人们对成功的向往。拼酷将鱼跃龙门的场景做成拼图，祝愿莘莘学子金榜题名，一举高中；职场精英平步青云，扬名立万。来拼一个镇宅宝物， 期待好运降临！

name: Wind-Rain Bridge
description: 风雨桥，桥梁的一种，形式多样，但以亭楼式结构居多。它一般由桥、塔、亭组成，桥面铺板，两旁设栏杆、长凳，桥顶盖瓦，形成长廊式走道，因行人往来能躲避风雨，故名风雨桥。其建筑结构不用一钉一铆，全靠木料凿榫衔接，被称为世界十大最不可思议桥梁之一。风雨桥楼阁飞檐重叠，桥身庄重巍峨，横跨溪河，如巨龙卧江，久经风雨，坚不可摧。

name: Daming Palace
description: 大明宫，大唐帝国的大朝正宫，有千宫之宫的美誉，是长安城最辉煌壮丽的宫殿群，规模宏大、格局完整，被称为“中国宫殿建筑的巅峰之作”。它始建于唐太宗贞观八年（634年），整个宫域包含大福殿、三清殿、承香殿等30余座建筑。1961年，大明宫遗址被列为全国重点文物保护单位；2014年，成功列入《世界遗产名录》。

name: Richelieu Battleship
description: 黎塞留号战列舰，隶属于法国，改造后成为二战时期欧洲综合性能最先进最强大的战列舰。它于1940年开始服役，满载排水量49850吨，舰长247.8米，航速32节，装有2座四联装380毫米主炮，3座三联装152毫米副炮等武器。其战斗足迹遍及三大洋，是法国参战地域最广，航行里程最长的战列舰，也是法国海军史上最著名的战列舰。

name: Ziwei Palace
description: 紫微宫，隋唐时期洛阳城皇宫部分，因“天有紫微宫，是上帝之所居也。王者立宫，象而为之”而得名。其规模是故宫的六倍，比大明宫多100万平方米，气势恢宏，奢华壮丽，成为后世宫殿建筑的范本。1988年，其部分遗址被列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位，有着重要的历史价值、科学价值和艺术价值。

name: The Old Summer Palace
description: 圆明园是清代大型皇家园林，被誉为造园艺术的典范和“万园之园”，曾以其宏大的地域规模、杰出的营造技艺、精美的建筑景群、丰富的文化收藏和博大精深的民族文化内涵而享誉于世。拼酷荟萃中西艺术，复刻惊艳历史之作，金银交汇，墨蓝点睛，取大水法一隅，雕猎狗逐鹿趣境，呈现出磅礴恢宏之势，一展皇家行宫的风采。

name: Notre Dame Cathedral Paris (Color)
description: 位于法国巴黎市中心、西堤岛，是天主教巴黎总教区的主教座堂，也是古老巴黎的象征。教堂以其哥特式的建筑风格，祭坛、回廊、门窗等处的雕刻和绘画艺术，以及堂内典藏的大量艺术珍品而闻名于世，闪烁着法国人民的智慧，反映了人们对美好生活的向往。作家雨果以巴黎圣母院为背景所著的同名小说为世界十大名著之一，享誉天下。

name: Ancient Academy
description: 私塾，大唐小街中的一景，青竹掩映，书声琅琅，儒雅庄重。这里藏书万卷，桃李满天下，培养了许多国之栋梁。每每经过，从轩窗中可窥见莘莘学子在勤学苦读。私塾的墙面上绘满松涛绿竹，书法、扇子等中式元素融汇其中，尤为雅致。学以聚之，问以辩之，让我们在书香中感受大唐的人文风情吧！

name: Ancient Theatrical Stage
description: 大唐小街里有一戏台，每天热闹不凡，精彩曲目轮番上演，台下观众喝彩连连！这座戏院华丽辉煌，三重檐结构尤显气派；绒球盔头和扎旗饰于顶部，威风凛凛；屋檐和大鼓上点缀脸谱元素，戏韵十足。好戏开锣，拼酷邀您来听一曲韵味悠长的贵妃醉酒！

name: Cloth Store
description: 在繁华的大唐小街，有一座充满少女心的建筑——布莊。这里面布匹种类繁多，花色丰富，不少达官贵人喜欢到此置办服饰。布莊的整体外观以粉色为主，古典又梦幻，侧面挂着不同花色的绸缎，随风飘扬，十分灵动。它的细节精巧，屋檐、栋梁、地板上遍布璀璨的花纹，在柔美的格调中增添华丽风采。

name: Yihong Garden
description: 怡红院坐落在大唐小街，造型华丽，金碧辉煌，怡红翠绿，别有一番韵味。在这座奢华的建筑里，汇聚了众多婀娜多姿，多才多艺的绝色女子，她们以才艺名扬天下。丝竹声声，载歌载舞，每天慕名而来的游客络绎不绝。怡红院3D金属拼图，将为你呈现繁华的大唐盛景。

name: Tang Dynasty Scenery Set
description: 大唐小街有一观景湖，小桥流水，碧波荡漾，湖上小舟摇曳，惬意悠然。湖边小贩云集，人来人往，热闹繁华。耍杂技的艺人、卖伞、卖风筝的阿翁、香飘四溢的茶摊、酒摊等汇聚其中，摩肩擦踵，川流不息。发挥你的创意，充分利用场景套装，打造自己心中的繁华闹市吧！

name: The Casino
description: 赌坊，大唐小街的娱乐中心，里面有各种棋牌项目为客人提供欢乐。它的造型张扬，檐角深远如飞鸟展翅；色彩绚丽夺目，大红大紫喜气洋洋；建筑各处悬挂着小骰子，寓意财源滚滚。每逢节庆，这里特别热闹，不少人们想借着节日喜气，到赌坊转运生财，赚个盆满钵满。

name: One Thousand Angle Lantern
description: 东莞千角灯，源自宋代宫灯，是糅合传统手工扎制与书画、剪纸、刺绣等多种艺术形式于一体的民间工艺瑰宝。东莞千角灯体积巨大，工艺精湛，缀有“千只角，千盏灯”，寓意“千角千灯人丁兴旺”。点灯后，千灯齐亮，灿若星河，令人惊叹！

name: Donghua Wonderland
description: 东华仙境，乃上古神邸，是位于天外天的避世净土。这里闪烁着银月之辉，聚集了天地灵气，仙鹤成群起舞，云雾缭绕，景色如诗如画。东华仙境（3D金属拼图）以浪漫格调刻画绝美意境，亭台楼阁，游廊相连，流光金、云水蓝和素雅白交相辉映，梦幻飘渺。仙界之门开启，拼酷邀你在拼装中探索奇妙仙踪。

name: Phoenix Festooned Vehicle
description: 每逢节日庆典，花车巡游是重要的庆贺方式，繁华街道上人潮如海，花车琳琅满目，好不热闹。醉霓裳是花车中的精品，通体金碧辉煌，犹如宫中凤辇，前端飞凤展翅，四周百花齐放，寓意盛世华安。车上彩灯高挂，帐穗摇曳，绝色舞姬随着琵琶琴声，旋转跳跃，载歌载舞，和万千民众齐贺盛典。

name: The Wind Breaker
description: 乘风破浪，是拼酷匠心巨制的 “天空之船”。整船黑金辉映，殷红点睛，船上亭台楼阁煌煌若仙宫，腾龙祥云纹融入精湛细节，寓意天降祥瑞，福泽延绵。扬帆起航，它卷起层层巨浪，激流之中宛若蛟龙，破浪乘风，气势磅礴！向你传达一帆风顺，好运满载，势如破竹的美好祝愿。

name: Phoenix Dance Vehicle
description: 大唐盛世，歌舞升平，无论是音乐舞蹈，还是艺术画作，均达到一个新的高度。从惊鸿舞到敦煌壁画，都在歌颂着唐代的繁华，而大唐小街中巡游的花鼓车，满载唐朝民众的喜乐，在长安城中蔓延开来。拼酷融合唐朝时期的歌舞、壁画与花车艺术，打造盛唐惊鸿鼓车，再次演绎盛世之美。

name: Fortune Amulet
description: 拼酷×罗马尼亚千纸鹤艺术家联合出品。传说，一天折一只纸鹤，坚持一千天，就可以给自己和喜欢的人带来幸福。千愿鹤承载着美好的祈愿与祝福，每款对应的愿望各不相同——守护健康、人缘、财富、好运、家宅和吉利。同时，它也是拼酷首款金属片盲盒。盲盒6款，随机抽取，附赠专属定制配件——许愿签、挂绳、许愿指南，惊喜感满分；套盒轻松集齐6款千愿鹤，360°好运加持。除盲盒已有专属配件外，套盒更配有千愿鹤装饰支架及艺术家精心准备的小彩蛋。 一起跟着拼酷和艺术家一起折千鹤、许心愿、添好运吧！

name: Saint Basil`s Cathedral (Color)
description: 瓦西里大教堂,位于莫斯科克里姆林宫外红场南端，是俄罗斯建筑师巴尔马和波斯特尼克，受沙皇伊凡大帝之命主持修建的东正教大教堂，于1560年建成。九个彩色洋葱头状的教堂顶是他的特色标志，整体设计体现了16世纪俄罗斯民间建筑艺术风格。拼酷高度还原九个标志性教堂顶、镂空花窗和纹理，在细节中再现教堂背后的历史印记。

name: London Eye (Large)

description: 安妮女王复仇号：原名协和号、南特的协和号，后由黑胡子将其改名为安妮女王复仇号。这条扬名七海的传奇船只让公海上的海盗们心生恐惧，据传其在航行时满载着从不幸的受害者那里抢来的财富和宝藏。船长黑胡子是世界航海史上最著名的海盗之一，他的事迹一直被改编进各类电影及电视，比如电影《加勒比海盗4：惊涛怪浪》以及漫画《海贼王》。

description: 壶,又称注子、注壶，最初的造型来源于青铜器， 多做盛酒器和茶具， 因器型、功用、审美被民众喜爱而流传至今。 执壶穿越千年生生不息， 执此一壶，饮尽风雅。

name: Nine Heavens Boat

description: 航天服,是航天员漫步太空时的底气.也是他们探寻未知时的保障,拼酷心怀对航天探索者的敬意,用全金属片打造身着航天服的「神舟航天员」,与光同行，奔赴星河,致敬伟大航天人.
